records.arabic: بن عبد المطلب ذكره هشام بن الكلبي وقال درج أي مات قبل ان يعقب
records.english: son of Abd al-Muttalib. Hisham ibn al-Kalbi mentioned him and said that he died—that is, he died without leaving descendants.

names.arabic: عمرو بن حمزة بن عبد المطلب
names.english: ʿAmr ibn Hamza ibn ʿAbd al-Muttalib

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن معاذ الأنصاري تقدم ذكره في القسم الأول وكان محمد بن عمرو بن علقمة يهم فيه فيقول عمر بن سعد بضم العين والصواب عمرو بفتحها
records.english: son of Muadh al-Ansari. He was mentioned above in the first section. Muhammad ibn ʿAmr ibn ʿAlqama used to err in his name and say “ʿUmar ibn Saʿd,” with a damma on the ʿayn. The correct form is ʿAmr, with a fatha.

names.arabic: عمرو بن سعد بن معاذ الأنصاري
names.english: ʿAmr ibn Saʿd ibn Muʿadh al-Ansari

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن عمرو العامري بن أخي سهيل بن عمرو ولد في عهد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وأمه صفية بنت عمرو بن عبد ود وسيأتي ذكرها
records.english: son of Amr al-ʿAmiri, the son of Suhayl ibn ʿAmr’s brother. He was born during the lifetime of the Prophet ﷺ. His mother was Safiyya bint ʿAmr ibn ʿAbd Wudd, who will be mentioned below.

names.arabic: عمرو بن سهل بن عمرو العامري
names.english: ʿAmr ibn Sahl ibn ʿAmr al-ʿAmiri

names.arabic: صفية بنت عمرو بن عبد ود
names.english: Safiyya bint ʿAmr ibn ʿAbd Wudd

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الأنصاري مات صغيرا في عهد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فصلى عليه روى الحاكم من طريق عمارة بن عروبة عن إسحاق عن أبي طلحة عن أبيه ان أبا طلحة دعا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى عمرو بن أبي طلحة حين توفي فأتاهم فصلى عليه في منزله إسناده صحيح
records.english: the Ansari; he died young in the lifetime of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, who prayed over him. Al-Hakim related through ʿUmara ibn ʿAruba, from Ishaq, from Abu Talha, from his father, that Abu Talha summoned the Messenger of God ﷺ to ʿAmr ibn Abi Talha when he died. He came to them and prayed over him in his home. Its chain is sound.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن نوفل القرشي بن أخت سعد بن أبي وقاص روى بن منده من طريق خلف بن أبي بكر بن عمرو بن نوفل الزهري عن أبيه حدثتني عاتكة بنت أبي وقاص أخت سعد قالت جئت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لما دخل مكة في ثمان نسوة ومعي ابناي فقلت هذان ابنا عمك وابنا خالتك فأخذ أحدهما عمرو بن عتبة بن نوفل وكان اصغرهما فوضعه في حجره الحديث
records.english: son of Nawfal al-Qurashi, the son of Saʿd ibn Abi Waqqas’s sister. Ibn Manda related through Khalaf ibn Abi Bakr ibn ʿAmr ibn Nawfal al-Zuhri, from his father: ʿAtika bint Abi Waqqas, Saʿd’s sister, related to me: “When the Messenger of God ﷺ entered Mecca, I came to him among eight women with my two sons. I said, ‘These two are the sons of your paternal uncle and the sons of your maternal aunt.’ He took one of them, ʿAmr ibn ʿUtba ibn Nawfal, who was the younger of the two, and placed him in his lap,” to the end of the hadith.

names.arabic: عمرو بن عتبة بن نوفل القرشي
names.english: ʿAmr ibn ʿUtba ibn Nawfal al-Qurashi

names.arabic: خلف بن أبي بكر بن عمرو بن نوفل الزهري
names.english: Khalaf ibn Abi Bakr ibn ʿAmr ibn Nawfal al-Zuhri

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن عمرو بن ربيعة القرشي العامري وكان أبوه ممن قام في نفض الصحيفة التي كتبتها قريش على بني هاشم ثم اسلم في الفتح وولد ابنه عمرو في الحياة النبوية وله عقب ذكره الزبير بن بكار
records.english: son of Amr, son of Rabia al-Qurashi al-ʿAmiri. His father was among those who acted to annul the document Quraysh had written against Banu Hashim. He then embraced Islam at the Conquest. His son ʿAmr was born during the Prophet’s lifetime and left descendants. Al-Zubayr ibn Bakkar mentioned him.

names.arabic: عمرو بن هشام بن عمرو بن ربيعة القرشي العامري
names.english: ʿAmr ibn Hisham ibn ʿAmr ibn Rabiʿa al-Qurashi al-ʿAmiri

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن عبيد الله التيمي أمه حمنة بنت جحش أخت أم المؤمنين زينب وذكر بن منده عن طلحة ما يدل على ان عمران ولد في حياة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فإنه اخرج بسند ضعيف عن موسى بن طلحة عن أبيه قال سمى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ابني موسى وعمران وذكره بن سعد في الطبقة الأولى
records.english: son of Ubayd Allah al-Taymi. His mother was Hamna bint Jahsh, sister of Zaynab, Mother of the Believers. Ibn Manda transmitted from Talha what indicates that ʿImran was born during the lifetime of the Prophet ﷺ. With a weak chain, he related from Musa ibn Talha, from his father, who said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ named my two sons Musa and ʿImran.” Ibn Saʿd included him in the first generation.

names.arabic: عمران بن طلحة بن عبيد الله التيمي
names.english: ʿImran ibn Talha ibn ʿUbayd Allah al-Taymi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن عمير بن هاشم بن عبد مناف بن عبد الدار القرشي العبدري قتل أبوه يزم أحد كافرا واعقب ولده عمير هذا ولدا اسمه مصعب قتل يوم الحرة ذكره البلاذري
records.english: son of Umayr, son of Hashim ibn ʿAbd Manaf ibn ʿAbd al-Dar al-Qurashi al-ʿAbdari. His father was killed as an unbeliever on the day of Uhud. This son of his, ʿUmayr, had a son named Musʿab who was killed on the day of al-Harra. Al-Baladhuri mentioned him.

names.arabic: عمير بن أبي عزيز بن عمير بن هاشم بن عبد مناف بن عبد الدار القرشي العبدري
names.english: ʿUmayr ibn Abi ʿAziz ibn ʿUmayr ibn Hashim ibn ʿAbd Manaf ibn ʿAbd al-Dar al-Qurashi al-ʿAbdari

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن حرب بن أمية بن عبد شمس القرشي الأموي أخو معاوية ذكره بن منده وقال أدرك النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ولا تصح له صحبة ولا رؤية قلت إذا أدرك الزمن النبوي حصلت له الرؤية لا محالة ولو من أحد الجانبين ولا سيما مع كونه من اصهار النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أخته أم حبيبة أم المؤمنين وقد اجتمع الجميع بمكة في حجة الوداع ولعنبسة رواية عن بعض الصحابة في صحيح مسلم وفي السنن روى عن أخته أم حبيبة وشداد بن أوس روى عنه أبو امامة الباهلي ويعلى بن عبيد وهما أكبر منه سنا وقد زاد عمرو بن أوس الثقفي والقاسم أبو عبد الرحمن ومكحول وعطاي وحسان بن عطية وغيرهم قال أبو نعيم اتفق متقدمو أئمتنا على انه من التابعين انتهى وولى مكة لأخيه معاوية وحج بالناس سنة ست أو سبع وأربعين وذكر خليفة ان معاوية امره على مكة فكان إذا توجه إلى الطائف استخلف طارق بن المرقع وروى النسائي من طريق عطاء عن يعلى بن أمية قال قدمت الطائف فدخلت على عنبسة بن أبي سفيان وهو في الموت فقال حدثتني أم حبيبة فذكر حديث من صلى في يوم اثنتي عشرة ركعة ورويناه في الكنجروديات من طريق عمرو بن أوس قال دخلت على عنبسة وهو في الموت فحدثني عن أخته أم حبيبة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال من صلى في النهار اثنتي عشرة ركعة دخل الجنة قال فما تركتهن منذ سمعته من أم حبيبة
records.english:
son of Harb, son of Umayya ibn ʿAbd Shams al-Qurashi al-Umawi, the brother of Muʿawiya. Ibn Manda mentioned him and said: He lived into the time of the Prophet ﷺ, but neither companionship nor sight of him is soundly established. I say: If he lived during the Prophetic period, he necessarily saw him, even if only one of the two saw the other. This is especially so because he was related to the Prophet ﷺ by marriage: his sister Umm Habiba was a Mother of the Believers, and all of them assembled in Mecca during the Farewell Pilgrimage.

ʿAnbasa transmitted from some of the Companions in Sahih Muslim and in the Sunan. He transmitted from his sister Umm Habiba and from Shaddad ibn Aws. Abu Umama al-Bahili and Yaʿla ibn ʿUbayd transmitted from him, though both were older than he. Also transmitting from him were ʿAmr ibn Aws al-Thaqafi, al-Qasim Abu ʿAbd al-Rahman, Makhul, ʿAtaʾ, Hassan ibn ʿAtiyya, and others. Abu Nuʿaym said: The earlier authorities among our imams agreed that he was one of the Successors. End quote.

He governed Mecca for his brother Muʿawiya and led the pilgrimage in the year forty-six or forty-seven. Khalifa mentioned that Muʿawiya appointed him over Mecca, and whenever he traveled to al-Taʾif he left Tariq ibn al-Muraqqaʿ as his deputy. Al-Nasaʾi related through ʿAtaʾ, from Yaʿla ibn Umayya, who said: I came to al-Taʾif and entered upon ʿAnbasa ibn Abi Sufyan while he was dying. He said, “Umm Habiba related to me,” then mentioned the hadith concerning one who prays twelve rakʿas in a day. We related in al-Kanjarudhiyyat through ʿAmr ibn Aws, who said: I entered upon ʿAnbasa while he was dying, and he related to me from his sister Umm Habiba, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said, “Whoever prays twelve rakʿas during the day will enter Paradise.” He said: “I have not abandoned them since I heard it from Umm Habiba.”

names.arabic: عنبسة بن أبي سفيان بن حرب بن أمية بن عبد شمس القرشي الأموي
names.english: ʿAnbasa ibn Abi Sufyan ibn Harb ibn Umayya ibn ʿAbd Shams al-Qurashi al-Umawi

records.arabic: بن عبد المطلب الهاشمي بن عم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم واحد الاخوة تقدم ذكره وذكره بن عبد البر في ترجمة أخيه تمام
records.english: son of Abd al-Muttalib al-Hashimi, the son of the paternal uncle of the Prophet ﷺ, and one of the brothers mentioned above. Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr mentioned him in the biography of his brother Tammam.

names.arabic: عون بن العباس بن عبد المطلب الهاشمي
names.english: ʿAwn ibn al-ʿAbbas ibn ʿAbd al-Muttalib al-Hashimi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن الحارث بن عبد المطلب بن عبد مناف القرشي المطلبي مات أبوه بعد وقعة بدر وكانت في رمضان من السنة الثانية فكأنه مات صغيرا فقد قال البلاذري وغيره انقرض عقب عبيدة بن الحارث
records.english: son of al-Harith, son of Abd al-Muttalib ibn ʿAbd Manaf al-Qurashi al-Muttalibi. His father died after the Battle of Badr, which took place in Ramadan of the second year, so it appears that he died young. Al-Baladhuri and others said that the line of ʿUbayda ibn al-Harith died out.

names.arabic: عون بن عبيدة بن الحارث بن عبد المطلب بن عبد مناف القرشي المطلبي
names.english: ʿAwn ibn ʿUbayda ibn al-Harith ibn ʿAbd al-Muttalib ibn ʿAbd Manaf al-Qurashi al-Muttalibi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن الخيار القرشي النوفلي أخو عبيد الله بالتصغير مات أبوه قبل فتح مكة فهو من أهل هذا القسم وله ولد اسمه عدي له ذكر وقتل الحرورية له ولدا بعد سنة ستين من الهجرة ذكره الزبير بن بكار
records.english: son of al-Khiyar al-Qurashi al-Nawfali, the brother of ʿUbayd Allah, in the diminutive form. His father died before the conquest of Mecca, so he belongs among the people of this section. He had a son named ʿAdi who is mentioned in the sources. The Haruriyya killed a son of his after the year sixty following the Hijra. Al-Zubayr ibn Bakkar mentioned him.

names.arabic: عياض بن عدي بن الخيار القرشي النوفلي
names.english: ʿIyad ibn ʿAdi ibn al-Khiyar al-Qurashi al-Nawfali

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
ذكر له الزبير بن بكار في الموفقيات قصة تدل على انه من أهل هذا القسم فاخرج من طريق علقمة بن حر السلمي قال جئت إلى معاوية فوجدت عنده بن وثيمة النضري وابن عارض الجشمي فذكر قصة فيها فقال بن عارض كنت مع أبي قبل ان يموت فوجدت في الطريق خشفا فصدته لابنة لأبي كان يحبها فخرجت محتضنه حتى وقفنا على دريد بن الصمة وقد فند عقله وهو عريان يكوم بين رجليه البطحاء فرفع رأسه فرأى الخشف فقال
كأنها رأس حضن
في يوم غيم ودجن
كالخشف هذا المحتضن
أحسن من شيء حسن ثم قام فسقط فقال
لا نهض في مثل زماني الأول
محدب الساق شديد الاسفل
يا أولى يا أولى يا أولى
قلت ودريد قتل يوم حنين وقيل بل قتل من قبل ذلك فمقتضاه ان يكون عارض وولده من أهل هذا القسم
records.english:
al-Zubayr ibn Bakkar related a story about him in al-Muwaffaqiyyat that indicates that he belongs among the people of this section. He transmitted through ʿAlqama ibn Hurr al-Sulami, who said: I came to Muʿawiya and found Ibn Wathima al-Nadri and Ibn ʿArid al-Jushami with him. He related a story in which Ibn ʿArid said: “I was with my father before he died. On the road I found a fawn, which I hunted for a daughter of my father whom he loved. I went out carrying it against my chest until we came upon Durayd ibn al-Simma. His mind had become senile, and he was naked, heaping the gravel between his legs. He raised his head, saw the fawn, and said:

It is as though she were the summit of Hadn
on a cloudy and overcast day;
like this fawn held to the breast,
more beautiful than any beautiful thing.

Then he stood up and fell, and said:

No rising now as in my former age,
with bowed shank and mighty lower frame.
Alas for the former days, the former days, the former days!”

I say: Durayd was killed on the day of Hunayn, though it is also said that he was killed before that. It follows that ʿArid and his son belong among the people of this section.

heading.arabic: ( القسم الثالث ) فيمن أدرك النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ولم يره
heading.english: (The Third Section): Those who lived during the time of the Prophet ﷺ but did not see him

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: السكوني الحمصي أدرك الجاهلية ووقد في خلافة أبي بكر وصحب معاذ بن جبل قاله بن سعد والدارقطني واما البزار فقال لا أدري اسمع منه واخرج أحمد في مسنده من طريق راشد بن سعد عن عاصم بن حميد وكان من أصحاب معاذ بن جبل عن معاذ وذكره أبو زرعة الدمشقي في الطبقة العليا من تابعي أهل الشام وسمع من عمر خطبته بالجابية وروى أيضا عن عوف بن مالك وروى عنه عمرو بن قيس السكوني وأزهر بن سعيد الحرازي وراشد بن سعد وغيرهم وقال بن القطان لا يعرف حاله وقد وثقه الدارقطني فكأن بن القطان لم يطلع على ذلك
records.english: of Sakun, from Homs; he lived in the pre-Islamic period. The supplied text next associates him with an action during the caliphate of Abu Bakr, but its damaged verb does not establish what he did. He also accompanied Muʿadh ibn Jabal. Ibn Saʿd and al-Daraqutni said this. Al-Bazzar, however, said: I do not know whether he heard from him. Ahmad related in his Musnad through Rashid ibn Saʿd, from ʿAsim ibn Humayd—who was one of the companions of Muʿadh ibn Jabal—from Muʿadh. Abu Zurʿa al-Dimashqi included him in the senior generation of the Successors of Syria. He heard ʿUmar’s sermon at al-Jabiya. He also transmitted from ʿAwf ibn Malik. ʿAmr ibn Qays al-Sakuni, Azhar ibn Saʿid al-Harazi, Rashid ibn Saʿd, and others transmitted from him. Ibn al-Qattan said: His standing is unknown. Al-Daraqutni had declared him trustworthy, so it appears that Ibn al-Qattan had not encountered that statement.

records.arabic: بن معقل بن صباح بن طريف بن زيد بن عمرو بن عامر بن كعب بن سعد بن ضبة الضبي الفارس المشهور في الجاهلية قال المرزباني في معجم الشعراء مخضرم سكن البصرة وقال المبرد في الكامل هو قاتل يسطام بن قيس بن خالد سيد بني سفيان وكان فارس بكر بن وائل فأغار على بني ضبة فاكتسح إبلهم فتنادوا فاتبعوه فنظرت أم عاصم بن خليفة إلى عاصم وهو يسن حديدة له فقالت ما تصنع بها قال اقتل بها بسطام بن قيس فنهرته فنظر إلى فرس لعمه موثقة في شجرة فركبها عريا فنظر بسطام إلى خيل بني ضبة وراءه فجعل يطعن الإبل في اعجازها وانحط عليه عاصم بن خليفة فطعنه فارداه على شجرة ليست بكبيرة يقال لها الألآءة وكان قتل بسطام والنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بمكة وكان نصرانيا وأراد اخوه ان يرجع إلى بني ضبة فقال له أبا حنيف ان رجعت ومات بسطام من تلك الطعنة وفي ذلك يقول بعض قومه مرثية له فخر على الألاءة لم يوسد كأن جبينه سيف صقيل قال ولما قتل بسطام لم يبق في بني بكر بن وائل بيت الا هدم وسكن عاصم بن خليفة البصرة وكان يأتي باب عثمان فيستأذن فيقول عاصم بن خليفة قاتل بسطام بن قيس بالباب
records.english:
son of Maqil, son of Sabah ibn Tarif ibn Zayd ibn ʿAmr ibn ʿAmir ibn Kaʿb ibn Saʿd ibn Dubba al-Dabbi, the famous horseman of the pre-Islamic period. Al-Marzubani said in Muʿjam al-Shuʿaraʾ: He lived in both the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods and settled in Basra. Al-Mubarrad said in al-Kamil: He was the killer of Bistam ibn Qays ibn Khalid, chief of Banu Shayban. Bistam was the horseman of Bakr ibn Waʾil. He raided Banu Dubba and swept away their camels. They raised the alarm and pursued him. ʿAsim ibn Khalifa’s mother saw ʿAsim sharpening an iron weapon and asked, “What are you doing with it?” He said, “I will kill Bistam ibn Qays with it.” She rebuked him. He saw a horse belonging to his paternal uncle tied to a tree, mounted it bareback, and rode off.

Bistam saw the cavalry of Banu Dubba behind him and began stabbing the camels in their hindquarters. ʿAsim ibn Khalifa bore down on him and stabbed him, casting him against a small tree called al-alaʾa. Bistam was killed while the Prophet ﷺ was in Mecca, and he was a Christian. His brother wanted to return to Banu Dubba, and someone said to him, addressing him as Abu Hanif, “If you return and Bistam dies from that wound …” One of his people said in an elegy for him:

He fell upon the alaʾa, with no cushion beneath him,
as though his brow were a polished sword.

He said: When Bistam was killed, there remained no household among Banu Bakr ibn Waʾil that was not torn down. ʿAsim ibn Khalifa settled in Basra. He used to come to ʿUthman’s door and seek permission to enter, saying, “ʿAsim ibn Khalifa, the killer of Bistam ibn Qays, is at the door.”

names.arabic: عاصم بن خليفة بن معقل بن صباح بن طريف بن زيد بن عمرو بن عامر بن كعب بن سعد بن ضبة الضبي
names.english: ʿAsim ibn Khalifa ibn Maʿqil ibn Sabah ibn Tarif ibn Zayd ibn ʿAmr ibn ʿAmir ibn Kaʿb ibn Saʿd ibn Dubba al-Dabbi

records.arabic: بن رافع بن مالك بن جلهمة بن يربوع بن سعد بن ثعلبة بن سعد بن عوف بن حدان بن غنم بن يحيى بن اعصر الغنوي ذكره أبو عبيدة معمر بن المثنى وقال كان جاهليا قبل ان يبعث النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال أبو عبيدة حدثني بذلك عبد الحميد بن عبد الواحد بن عاصم بن عبد الله بن رافع حدثني جدي وعمي صفوان عن أبيهما عاصم قال وكان يقول حدثني من أدرك مقتل شاس بن زهير فذكر القصة
records.english: son of Rafi, son of Malik ibn Jalhama ibn Yarbuʿ ibn Saʿd ibn Thaʿlaba ibn Saʿd ibn ʿAwf ibn Haddan ibn Ghanm ibn Yahya ibn Aʿsur al-Ghanawi. Abu ʿUbayda Maʿmar ibn al-Muthanna mentioned him and said: He lived in the pre-Islamic period before the Prophet ﷺ was sent. Abu ʿUbayda said: ʿAbd al-Hamid ibn ʿAbd al-Wahid ibn ʿAsim ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Rafiʿ related that to me: My grandfather and my paternal uncle Safwan related to me, from their father ʿAsim. He used to say, “One who witnessed the killing of Shaʾs ibn Zuhayr related to me,” and then he told the story.

names.arabic: عاصم بن عبد الله بن رافع بن مالك بن جلهمة بن يربوع بن سعد بن ثعلبة بن سعد بن عوف بن حدان بن غنم بن يحيى بن اعصر الغنوي

names.arabic: عبد الحميد بن عبد الواحد بن عاصم بن عبد الله بن رافع
names.english: ʿAbd al-Hamid ibn ʿAbd al-Wahid ibn ʿAsim ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Rafiʿ

records.arabic: له إدراك وكان في خلافة عمر رجلا ولم ار من ذكره في الصحابة وقع ذكره في حديث أخرجه الزبير بن بكار في أخبار المدينة قال حدثني محمد بن الحسن يعني بن زبالة عن عبد العزيز وهو الدراوردي عن موسى بن محمد بن إبراهيم التيمي عن أبيه ان سعد بن أبي وقاص وجد جارية لعاصية السلمي تقطع من الحمى فضربها وسلبها فدخل عاصية السلمي على عمر فاستعدى على سعد فقال له عمر اردد إليها ثوبها وفأسها واما بن إسحاق فقال لا أرد غنيمة غنمنيها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وفي صحيح مسلم قصة لسعد تشبه هذه لكن ليس فيها ذكر عاصية ولا عمر بل فيها انه وجد عبدا يقطع وفي سنن أبي داود لسعد قصة أخرى كذلك وفيها انه رأى رجلا يصيد
records.english: He lived into the Islamic period and was an adult during Umar's caliphate. I have not seen anyone include him among the Companions. He is mentioned in a hadith that al-Zubayr ibn Bakkar cited in Akhbar al-Madina. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, meaning Ibn Zabala, related to me, from ʿAbd al-ʿAziz, namely al-Darawardi, from Musa ibn Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Taymi, from his father, that Saʿd ibn Abi Waqqas found a slave girl belonging to ʿAsiya al-Sulami cutting vegetation in the protected pasture. He beat her and stripped her of her possessions. ʿAsiya al-Sulami went in to ʿUmar and sought judgment against Saʿd. ʿUmar told him, “Return her garment and her axe to her.” Ibn Ishaq, however, has: “I will not return spoils that the Messenger of God ﷺ granted me.” In Sahih Muslim there is a story about Saʿd resembling this one, but it does not mention ʿAsiya or ʿUmar; rather, it says that he found a male slave cutting vegetation. In Sunan Abi Dawud there is another similar story about Saʿd in which he saw a man hunting.

names.arabic: موسى بن محمد بن إبراهيم التيمي
names.english: Musa ibn Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Taymi

records.arabic:
الحضرمي ذكره بن دريد في أماليه وأورد من طريق هشام بن الكلبي عن أبيه محمد بن السائب الكلبي قال حدثني شيخ من حضرموت بمكة وتذاكرنا اولية العرب عن أبيه واسمه عامر بن جحدم عن جده وكان جاهليا قال كان بحضرموت شيخ فذكر قصة وأنشد فيها لولد ذلك الشيخ
من مات فالحي له مباعد
بسرعة البغض بئس الزائد
والزرع يجنى لحصاد الحاصد
كم ولد يحيى بموت الوالد ويحتمل ان يكون الإدراك لجحدم والد عامر وقد نبهت عليه في حرف الجيم

records.arabic: بن قيس ويقال عامر بن عبد قيس بن ناشب بن أسامة بن حذيفة بن معاوية التميمي العنبري أبو عبد الله أو أبو عمرو النصرى الزاهد المشهور يقال أدرك الجاهلية حكاه أبو موسى في الذيل وروى البخاري في تاريخه من طريق أبي كعب قال كان الحسن وابن سيرين يكرهان ان يقولا عامر بن عبد قيس ويقولان عامر بن عبد الله وذكر سيف في الفتوح من طريق أبي عبيدة العصفري انه كان فيمن شهد فتح المدائن وقال العجلي تابعي ثقة من كبار التابعين وعبادهم واما كعب الأحبار فقال هذا راهب هذه الأمة وأخرج ابن سعد عن عمرو بن عاصم عن جعفر بن سليمان عن مالك بن دينار قال لما رأى كعب عامرا بالشام فذكره وروى بن أبي الدنيا من طرق انه كان فرض على نفسه كل يوم ألف ركعة وروى أبو نعيم في الحلية من طريق مالك بن دينار قال مر عامر بن عبد قيس بقافلة حبسها الأسد فقال ما لكم قالوا الأسد فمر هو حتى أصاب ثوبه فم الأسد وروى بن المبارك في الزهد من طريق بلال بن سعد ان عامر بن عبد قيس وشى به إلى عثمان فأمر ان ينفي إلى الشام على قتب انزله معاوية الخضراء وبعث اليه بجارية وامرها ان تعلمه ما حاله فكان يقوم الليل كله ويخرج من السحر فلا يعود الا بعد العتمة ولا يتناول من طعام معاوية شيئا كان يجيء معه بكسر فيجعلها في ماء فيأكلها ويشرب من ذلك الماء فكتب معاوية إلى عثمان بحاله فامره ان يصله ويدنيه فقال لا ارب لي في ذلك قال بلال بن سعد فأخبرني من رآه بأرض الروم على بغلته تلك يركبها عقبة ويحمل عليها عقبه وعند بن أبي الدنيا من طريق عامر بن يسار سمعت المعلى بن زياد يقول كان عامر بن عبد الله دعا ربه ان يهون عليه الطهور في الشتاء فكان يؤتى بالماء له بخار وسأل ربه ان ينزع منه شهوة النساء من قلب ففعل فكان لا يبالي من لقى اذكر أم أنثى وكان إذا غزا قال اني لاستحى من ربي ان أخشى غيره وروى بن المبارك في الزهد من طريق العلاء بن الشخير عن عامر بن عبد قيس كان يأخذ عطاءه فيجعله في طرف ثوبه فلا يلقاه أحد من المساكين الا أعطاه فإذا دخل بيته رمى به إليهم فيجدونها فيجونها سواء كما أعطيها وعن ضمرة عن بن عطاء عن أبيه قال قبر عامر بن عبد الله ببيت المقدس وقال غيره وذلك في خلافة معاوية
records.english:
son of Qays. He is also called ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Qays ibn Nashib ibn Usama ibn Hudhayfa ibn Muʿawiya al-Tamimi al-ʿAnbari, Abu ʿAbd Allah or Abu ʿAmr al-Nasri, the famous ascetic. It is said that he lived through the pre-Islamic period; Abu Musa related this in al-Dhayl. Al-Bukhari transmitted in his History, through Abu Kaʿb, who said: Al-Hasan and Ibn Sirin disliked saying “ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Qays” and would say “ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Allah.” Sayf mentioned in al-Futuh, through Abu ʿUbayda al-ʿAsfari, that he was among those present at the conquest of al-Madaʾin. Al-ʿIjli said: He was a trustworthy Successor and one of the senior Successors and worshippers. Kaʿb al-Ahbar said: “This is the monk of this community.” Ibn Saʿd transmitted from ʿAmr ibn ʿAsim, from Jaʿfar ibn Sulayman, from Malik ibn Dinar, that when Kaʿb saw ʿAmir in Syria—then he mentioned it.

Ibn Abi al-Dunya related through several routes that he had imposed upon himself one thousand rakʿas every day. Abu Nuʿaym related in al-Hilya through Malik ibn Dinar, who said: ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Qays passed a caravan that a lion had held up. He asked, “What is wrong with you?” They said, “The lion.” He passed by it until the lion’s mouth touched his garment.

Ibn al-Mubarak related in al-Zuhd through Bilal ibn Saʿd that someone denounced ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Qays to ʿUthman, so he ordered that he be exiled to Syria on a pack saddle. Muʿawiya lodged him at al-Khadraʾ and sent him a slave girl, instructing her to learn about his condition. He would stand in prayer all night, go out before dawn, and not return until after the night prayer. He took none of Muʿawiya’s food. He would bring pieces of bread with him, place them in water, eat them, and drink that water. Muʿawiya wrote to ʿUthman about his condition, and he instructed him to give him gifts and draw him near. ʿAmir said, “I have no need of that.” Bilal ibn Saʿd said: Someone who saw him in Byzantine territory informed me that he was on that same mule, riding it by turns and loading his baggage on it.

Ibn Abi al-Dunya also related, through ʿAmir ibn Yasar: I heard al-Muʿalla ibn Ziyad say: ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Allah prayed to his Lord to make purification easy for him in winter, and water was brought to him with steam rising from it. He asked his Lord to remove desire for women from his heart, and He did so. He did not care whether the person he met was male or female. Whenever he went on campaign, he said, “I am ashamed before my Lord to fear anyone other than Him.”

Ibn al-Mubarak related in al-Zuhd through al-ʿAlaʾ ibn al-Shikhkhir that ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Qays would take his stipend and place it in the end of his garment. No needy person met him without his giving something to him. When he entered his home, he threw it to his family, and they found it exactly as it had been given to him. From Damra, from Ibn ʿAtaʾ, from his father, who said: ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Allah’s grave is in Jerusalem. Another said that this was during Muʿawiya’s caliphate.

aliases: ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Qays ibn Nashib ibn Usama ibn Hudhayfa ibn Muʿawiya al-Tamimi al-ʿAnbari
names.arabic: عامر بن عبد قيس بن قيس
names.english: ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Qays ibn Qays

records.arabic: له إدراك ذكر الطبري ان العلاء بن الحضرمي كتب اليه يأمره بالتمادي على جده واجتهاده في قتال أهل الردة والفحص عن امورهم والتتبع لاخبارهم ذكره بن فتحون قلت ولم ينسبه فان كان هو أخا أبي سلمة بن عبد الأسد المخزومي زوج أم سلمة فهو صحابي
records.english: He lived into the Islamic period. Al-Tabari mentioned that al-ʿAlaʾ ibn al-Hadrami wrote to him, ordering him to persist in his earnestness and exertion in fighting the apostates, to investigate their affairs, and to pursue reports about them. Ibn Fathun mentioned him. I say: He did not give his lineage. If this man was the brother of Abu Salama ibn ʿAbd al-Asad al-Makhzumi, the husband of Umm Salama, then he was a Companion.

names.arabic: أبي سلمة بن عبد الأسد المخزومي
names.english: Abu Salama ibn ʿAbd al-Asad al-Makhzumi

records.arabic: بن حصن بن ربيعة بن بدر الفزاري لعمه عيينة بن حصن صحبة وله هو إدراك وكان ابنه نصر بن عقبة شاعرا في دولة بني أمية وهاجي عويف القوافي وكان يقال له نصر بن طوعة وهي أخته وأنشد له المرزباني في معجمه ولو عصم الرجال من المنايا بلاء الصدق والحسب التليد تجنبت المرادي ذاك حصن فلم يصطدهم فيمن يصيد
records.english:
son of Hisn, son of Rabia, son of Badr al-Fazari. His paternal uncle ʿUyayna ibn Hisn was a Companion, and he himself lived into Islam. His son Nasr ibn ʿUqba was a poet under the Umayyad dynasty and exchanged invective with ʿUwayf al-Qawafi. He was called Nasr ibn Tawʿa, Tawʿa being his sister. Al-Marzubani quoted him in his Muʿjam:

If true valor and ancient lineage could protect
men from death,
then Hisn would have escaped that Muradi;
the Muradi would not have caught him among those whom he catches.

names.arabic: عامر بن عقبة بن حصن بن ربيعة بن بدر الفزاري
names.english: ʿAmir ibn ʿUqba ibn Hisn ibn Rabiʿa ibn Badr al-Fazari

records.arabic: بن شكل بن كعب بن الحريش بن كعب العامري ثم الحرشي قال بن الكلبي كان سيد بني عامر في زمانه وله قصة مع زفر بن الحارث عند عبد الملك بن مروان وكان يقال لعامر ذو الغصة
records.english: son of Shakl, son of Kab ibn al-Harish ibn Kaʿb al-ʿAmiri, then al-Harishi. Ibn al-Kalbi said: He was the chief of Banu ʿAmir in his time. He has a story with Zufar ibn al-Harith in the presence of ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Marwan. ʿAmir was called Dhu al-Ghussa.

names.arabic: عامر بن مالك الأسلع بن شكل بن كعب بن الحريش بن كعب العامري ثم الحرشي
names.english: ʿAmir ibn Malik al-Aslaʿ ibn Shakal ibn Kaʿb ibn al-Harish ibn Kaʿb al-ʿAmiri, then al-Harishi

records.arabic: مولى مراد له إدراك ذكره أبو عمر الكندي في اشراف الموالي من أهل مصر وأسند من طريق سعيد بن عفير انه كان قدم من اليمن مع مواليه حتى شهد الفتح بالشام ويقال انه كان من أهل ارسفيه فقدم دمشق بزقاق خمر يبيعها فرغب في الإسلام فاسلم وموالي عبد الله بن يزيد الحملي فقيل له عامر حمل ثم سار مع عمرو بن العاص فشهد فتح مصر
records.english: a client of Murad who lived into the Islamic period. Abu ʿUmar al-Kindi mentioned him in Ashraf al-Mawali among the people of Egypt and supplied a chain through Saʿid ibn ʿUfair stating that he came from Yemen with his patrons and witnessed the conquest of Syria. It is said that he was from the people of Arsufiyya and came to Damascus with a wineskin to sell. He became drawn to Islam and embraced it. His patrons were those of ʿAbd Allah ibn Yazid al-Hamli, so he was called ʿAmir Hamal. Then he traveled with ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAs and witnessed the conquest of Egypt.

records.arabic: الجرمزي بضم الجيم والميم بينهما راء ساكنة ثم زاي منقوطة يأتي ذكره في عبد الله بن خليفة البولاني
records.english: al-Jurmuzi: the jim and mim have damma, with a vowelless ra between them, followed by a dotted zay. He will be mentioned under ʿAbd Allah ibn Khalifa al-Bulani.

records.arabic: واسمه مالك بن عوف بن قريع بن بكر بن ثعلبة له إدراك وكان ابنه عبد الله بن عائذ مع معاوية ذكره بن الكلبي
records.english: whose name was Malik ibn Awf ibn Qurayʿ ibn Bakr ibn Thaʿlaba. He lived into the Islamic period. His son ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿAʾidh was with Muʿawiya. Ibn al-Kalbi mentioned him.

records.arabic: بن دريد صبح بن عبيد بن قمير بن سلامة بن زوى بن مالك بن نهد النهدي كان سيدهم في الجاهلية ثم اسلم فكان يقال له الناسك ذكره بن الكلبي
records.english: son of Durayd Subh ibn ʿUbayd ibn Qumayr ibn Salama ibn Zuwa ibn Malik ibn Nahd al-Nahdi. He was their chief in the pre-Islamic period. He then embraced Islam and was called “the Devout.” Ibn al-Kalbi mentioned him.

names.arabic: عائش بن الصامت بن دريد صبح بن عبيد بن قمير بن سلامة بن زوى بن مالك بن نهد النهدي

records.arabic: العنزي له إدراك وقصة مع أبي بكر الصديق ذكرها أبو الفرج الأصبهاني في ترجمة أبي العتاهية الشاعر فروى عن محمد بن يحيى الصولي عن محمد بن موسى بن حماد قال كان كيسان جد أبي العتاهية الأعلى من أهل عين التمر فسبى مع من سبى في غزاة خالد بن الوليد وكان يتيما فلما حضروا عند أبي بكر جعل أبو بكر يسألهم واحدا واحدا عن انسابهم فيخبره كل واحد منهم بمبلغ معرفته حتى سأل كيسان فذكر انه من عنزة وبحضرة أبي بكر يومئذ عباد بن رفاعة أحد بني هدم بن عنزة بن أسد بن ربيعة بن نزار فاستوهبه من أبي بكر وكان قد صار خالصا له فوهبه له فأعتقه
records.english: of Anaza; he lived into the Islamic period and has a story involving Abu Bakr al-Siddiq. Abu al-Faraj al-Isbahani mentioned it in the biography of the poet Abu al-ʿAtahiya. He related from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Suli, from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Hammad, who said: Kaysan, Abu al-ʿAtahiya’s highest known ancestor, was from ʿAyn al-Tamr. He was taken captive with those captured during Khalid ibn al-Walid’s campaign, and he was an orphan. When they were brought before Abu Bakr, Abu Bakr questioned them one by one about their lineages, and each told him as much as he knew. When he asked Kaysan, Kaysan stated that he was from ʿAnaza. Present with Abu Bakr that day was ʿAbbad ibn Rifaʿa, one of Banu Hadm ibn ʿAnaza ibn Asad ibn Rabiʿa ibn Nizar. He asked Abu Bakr to grant him Kaysan, who had become Abu Bakr’s exclusive property. Abu Bakr gave him to him, and he manumitted him.

names.arabic: بني هدم بن عنزة بن أسد بن ربيعة بن نزار
names.english: Banu Hadm ibn ʿAnaza ibn Asad ibn Rabiʿa ibn Nizar

records.english: son of al-Numan al-Thaʿlabi. He lived into the Islamic period and is mentioned in the biography of al-Saffah ibn Matar in al-Bukhari’s History.

names.arabic: عباد بن زرعة بن النعمان الثعلبي
names.english: ʿAbbad ibn Zurʿa ibn al-Nuʿman al-Thaʿlabi

records.arabic: له إدراك وحج مع عمر بن الخطاب فروى البخاري من طريق الحارث بن عبيد عن هود بن شهاب بن عباد عن أبيه عن جده قال مر عمر بن الخطاب على أبيات بعرفة فقال لمن هذه فقلنا لعبد القيس فقال لهم خيرا
records.english: He lived into the Islamic period and performed the pilgrimage with Umar ibn al-Khattab. Al-Bukhari related through al-Harith ibn ʿUbayd, from Hud ibn Shihab ibn ʿAbbad, from his father, from his grandfather, who said: ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab passed by some tents at ʿArafa and asked, “Whose are these?” We said, “They belong to ʿAbd al-Qays,” and he spoke well of them.

records.arabic: له إدراك شهد بعض الفتوح في زمن أبي بكر ذكره سيف
records.english: He lived into the Islamic period and took part in some of the conquests in Abu Bakr's time. Sayf mentioned him.

records.arabic: بن شراحيل بن الشيطان بن الحارث بن الاصهب الجعفي له إدراك وقد تقدم ذكر بن عمه سلمان بن ثمامة بن شراحيل في القسم الأول وان له وفادة ويأتي ذكر بن عمه الآخر قيس بن سلمة بن شراحيل وله وفادة أيضا ولم ار من ذكر لعبد الله هذا وفادة وذكر بن الكلبي انه كان مع بن عمه سلمان وقومه لما اعتزلوا القتال بالرقة مع علي ومعاوية قال وكانوا ثمانين رجلا وذكر له قصة مع بشر بن مروان لما كان أمير الكوفة وانه خطب يوما فتكلم بشيء فقام اليه فقال له اتق الله فإنك ميت ومحاسب فأمر بضربه فضرب بالسياط فمات
records.english: son of Sharahil, son of al-Shaytan, son of al-Harith ibn al-Ashhab al-Juʿfi. He lived into the Islamic period. His paternal cousin Salman ibn Thumama ibn Sharahil was mentioned above in the first section as having come in a delegation. His other paternal cousin, Qays ibn Salama ibn Sharahil, will be mentioned below, and he too came in a delegation. I have not seen anyone state that this ʿAbd Allah came in a delegation. Ibn al-Kalbi mentioned that he was with his paternal cousin Salman and their people when they held themselves apart from the fighting at al-Raqqa between ʿAli and Muʿawiya. He said that they were eighty men. He also related an incident involving him and Bishr ibn Marwan when Bishr was governor of Kufa. Bishr delivered a sermon one day and said something, whereupon ʿAbd Allah stood and said to him, “Fear God, for you will die and be called to account.” Bishr ordered that he be beaten. He was flogged and died.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن أرطاة بن شراحيل بن الشيطان بن الحارث بن الاصهب الجعفي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Artaʾa ibn Sharahil ibn al-Shaytan ibn al-Harith ibn al-Ashhab al-Juʿfi

records.english: of Khawlan, then of Jadad; he lived into the Islamic period and witnessed the conquest of Egypt in the company of ʿAmr. Ibn Yunus said this.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن اسيد الخولاني ثم الجدادي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Usayd al-Khawlani, then al-Jadadi

records.arabic: الحبشي ولد النجاشي ذكر الزبير بن بكار ان أسماء بنت عميس ارضعته مع ولدها عبد الله بن جعفر لما كانت بالحبشة حتى فطم
records.english: the Abyssinian, son of the Negus. Al-Zubayr ibn Bakkar mentioned that Asmaʾ bint ʿUmays nursed him together with her son ʿAbd Allah ibn Jaʿfar while she was in Abyssinia, until he was weaned.

names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Ashama the Abyssinian

records.arabic: بن حذلم الأسدي قال بن عساكر له إدراك وقدم دمشق صحبة خالد بن الوليد ونزل داخل الجابية وهو جد بني حذلم قضاة دمشق ذكره أبو الحسن الرازي والد تمام ويقال ان لأبيه صحبة
records.english: son of Hadhlam al-Asadi. Ibn ʿAsakir said: He lived into the Islamic period, came to Damascus in the company of Khalid ibn al-Walid, and settled within al-Jabiya. He was the ancestor of Banu Hadhlam, the judges of Damascus. Abu al-Hasan al-Razi, the father of Tammam, mentioned him. It is said that his father was a Companion.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن بكر بن حذلم الأسدي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Bakr ibn Hadhlam al-Asadi

records.arabic:
بن عبد الله بن أصرم الهلالي أبو ليلى ذكره الذهبي في التجريد بعد عبد الله بن البراء وقال ذكره بن الأثير قلت ولم أره في أسد الغابة في بعض النسخ ورأيت بخط بعض من نقل عن بن الأثير انه قال انه مخضرم ورأيته في معجم الشعراء للمرزباني وقال هو جد زفر بن عاصم وهو شاعر شامي وهو القائل في لبابة بنت الحارث الهلالية زوج العباس بن عبد المطلب
ما ولدت نجيبة من فحل
نسمة من نسل أم الفضل
اكرم به من كهلة من كهل
عم النبي المصطفى ذي الفضل وضبط الرضى الشاطبي أباه بموحدة ومهملة مصغرا
records.english:
son of Abd Allah, son of Asram al-Hilali, Abu Layla. Al-Dhahabi mentioned him in al-Tajrid after ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Baraʾ and said: Ibn al-Athir mentioned him. I say: I did not see him in some copies of Usd al-Ghaba. I saw in the handwriting of someone who transmitted from Ibn al-Athir that he said he lived in both the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods. I also found him in al-Marzubani’s Muʿjam al-Shuʿaraʾ. He said: He was the grandfather of Zufar ibn ʿAsim and was a Syrian poet. He is the one who said concerning Lubaba bint al-Harith al-Hilaliyya, wife of al-ʿAbbas ibn ʿAbd al-Muttalib:

No noble woman by a stallion ever bore
a soul descended from Umm al-Fadl.
How noble an elder, descended from an elder:
the uncle of the chosen Prophet, possessor of virtue.

Al-Radi al-Shatibi gave his father’s name in the diminutive, with the single-dotted baʾ and an unpointed consonant.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن بريد بن عبد الله بن أصرم الهلالي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Burayd ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Asram al-Hilali

records.english: with damma on the tha, fatha on the waw, and then a ba—Abu Salama al-Khawlani. He is famous by his kunyah and will appear under the kunyahs.

records.arabic: بن رفاعة السعدي أخو النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم سماه الواقدي وقال بن سعد حدثنا عمرو بن عاصم حدثنا همام بن يحيى عن إسحاق بن عبد الله بن أبي طلحة قال كان للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أخ رضيع قال فجعل يقول له اترى انه يكون بعث بعد الموت فيقول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أي والذي نفسي بيده لآخذن بيدك يوم القيامة ولأعرفنك قال فلما آمن بعد موت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم جعل يبكى ويقول أرجو ان يأخذ النبي صلى الله عيه وآله وسلم بيدي يوم القيامة فانجو وهذا مرسل صحيح الإسناد
records.english: son of Rifaa al-Saʿdi, the foster brother of the Prophet ﷺ. Al-Waqidi gave this as his name. Ibn Saʿd said: ʿAmr ibn ʿAsim related to us; Hammam ibn Yahya related to us, from Ishaq ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Abi Talha, who said: The Prophet ﷺ had a foster brother who used to ask him, “Do you think there will be a resurrection after death?” The Prophet ﷺ would say, “Yes, by Him in whose hand is my soul, I shall take you by the hand on the Day of Resurrection, and I shall recognize you.” When he embraced the faith after the death of the Prophet ﷺ, he would weep and say, “I hope that the Prophet ﵌ will take me by the hand on the Day of Resurrection and that I shall be saved.” This is a disconnected report with a sound chain.

names.english: Ishaq ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Abi Talha

title.arabic: عبد الله بن الحارث بن عبد العزي
title.english: Abd Allah ibn al-Harith ibn Abd al-Uzza

records.arabic:
ذكره وثيمة في كتاب الردة فيمن ثبت على إسلامه وأنشد له في ذلك قوله
الا ابلغ أبا بكر رسولا
وفتيان المدينة اجمعينا
فهل لكم إلى قوم كرام
قعود في جواثي محصرينا
توكلنا على الرحمن انا
وجدنا النصر للمتوكلينا
وقلنا قد رضينا الله ربا
وبالإسلام دينا قد رضينا وذكره الطبري في مواضع منها انه دل العلاء بن الحضرمي على عورة قومه حتى ظفر بهم وذلك ان الجارود كان قوم من بكر بن وائل اسروه فكتب إلى المسلمين ان هؤلاء القوم الذين انا في اسرهم ضباع بالليل اسود بالنهار فقال العلاء من يدلنا عليهم فقال عبد الله بن حذق انا فلما اقترب منهم اخذوه فصاح وكانت أمه عجلية فصاح يا ابجراه فقال الابجر من أنت قال بن أمتك عبد الله بن حذق قال خلوه ويحك مالك قال خرجت من الجهد فأطعموني شيئا فأطعمه وقال اني لاحسب انك بئس بن أخت القوم الليلة لاخوالك ثم اقبلوا على شرابهم وغفلوا عنه فهرب إلى العلاء فبينهم العلاء فكانت هزيمتهم وذكر بن الكلبي في نسب بني عامر عبد الله بن حذق بن عبد الله بن عوف بن شداد بن ربيعة بن عبد الله بن أبي بكر بن كلاب بأنه شاعر فلعله هذا
records.english:
Wathima mentioned him in the Book of the Ridda among those who remained firm in Islam and quoted him as saying about that:

Carry a message to Abu Bakr,
and to all the young men of Medina:
Will you come to noble people
who sit besieged in Juwatha?
We put our trust in the All-Merciful, for we
have found victory belongs to those who trust.
We said: We are pleased with God as Lord,
and we are pleased with Islam as religion.

Al-Tabari mentioned him in several places. Among them, he stated that he showed al-ʿAlaʾ ibn al-Hadrami the vulnerable point of his own people, enabling al-ʿAlaʾ to defeat them. Al-Jarud had been taken prisoner by some people of Bakr ibn Waʾil, and he wrote to the Muslims: “These people by whom I am held captive are hyenas by night and lions by day.” Al-ʿAlaʾ asked, “Who will guide us to them?” ʿAbd Allah ibn Hudhaq said, “I will.” When he drew near them, they seized him. His mother was an ʿIjli woman, so he cried, “O Abjar!” Al-Abjar asked, “Who are you?” He replied, “The son of your bondwoman, ʿAbd Allah ibn Hudhaq.” He said, “Release him. Woe to you, what is wrong?” He said, “I came out because of hunger, so give me something to eat.” He fed him and said, “I reckon you will be a wretched nephew to your maternal uncles tonight.” They then turned to their drink and became heedless of him. He escaped to al-ʿAlaʾ, and al-ʿAlaʾ fell upon them, bringing about their defeat.

Ibn al-Kalbi mentioned in the genealogy of Banu ʿAmir that ʿAbd Allah ibn Hudhaq ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿAwf ibn Shaddad ibn Rabiʿa ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Abi Bakr ibn Kilab was a poet. Perhaps this was the same man.

records.arabic: العنسي ذكره بن عساكر وقال له إدراك واخرج بن عائذ في المغازي من طريق بن لهيعة عن يزيد بن أبي حبيب قال بلغ عمر بن الخطاب ان عبد الله الحر العنسي زرع أرضا بالشام فانهب زرعه وقال انطلقت إلى ذل وصغار في اعناق الكبار فجعلته في عنقك قال بن عساكر كانت له قطعة بباب كيسان
records.english: of Ans; Ibn Asakir mentioned him and said that he lived into the Islamic period. Ibn ʿAʾidh related in al-Maghazi, through Ibn Lahiʿa, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, who said: It reached ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab that ʿAbd Allah al-Hurr al-ʿAnsi had cultivated land in Syria, so he ordered his crop to be given up for plunder and said, “You went to a humiliation and abasement borne on the necks of the great, and placed it upon your own neck.” Ibn ʿAsakir said: He owned a plot by Bab Kaysan.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: أدرك عمر روى عنه أبو علي الكاهلي قصة لأبي موسى أخرجها أحمد من رواية عبد الملك العرزمي عن أبي علي رجل من كاهل قال خطبنا أبو موسى الأشعري فذكر شيئا فقام اليه عبد الله بن حزن وقيس بن المضارب فقالا لتخرجن مما قلت أو لنأتين عمر فقال بل اخرج مما قلت فذكر حديث انا نعوذ بك من ان نشرك بك شيئا نعلمه ونستغفرك مما لا نعلمه وهذان الرجلان من المخضرمين لان من يكون في زمن عمر يخوف اميره يعمر دون أخواله لا بد ان يكون أدرك العصر النبوي
records.english: He lived to the time of Umar. Abu ʿAli al-Kahili transmitted from him an incident involving Abu Musa. Ahmad cited it through ʿAbd al-Malik al-ʿArzami, from Abu ʿAli, a man of Kahil, who said: Abu Musa al-Ashʿari delivered a sermon to us and mentioned something. ʿAbd Allah ibn Hazn and Qays ibn al-Mudarib stood before him and said, “You will withdraw what you said, or we will go to ʿUmar.” He replied, “Rather, I withdraw what I said.” He then mentioned the hadith: “We seek refuge in You from knowingly associating anything with You, and we ask Your forgiveness for what we do not know.” These two men were among those who lived in both the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods. Ibn Hajar’s inference is that someone who, in ʿUmar’s time, could threaten his governor with recourse to ʿUmar must have lived through the Prophetic period; however, the intervening words in the supplied clause are corrupt and remain unresolved.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: البكري ذكره بن إسحاق في المغازي قال بن أبي نجيح عن عبد الله بن عبيد بن عمير عن عبد الله بن الخريت وكان قد أدرك الجاهلية قال لم يكن في قريش فخذ الا ولهم ناد معلوم في المسجد الحرام يجلسون فيه وكان لبني بكر مجلس فبينا نحن جلوس في المسجد إذ اقبل غلام فذكر قصة حرمة الكعبة في الجاهلية
records.english: of Bakr; Ibn Ishaq mentioned him in the Maghazi. Ibn Abi Najih said, from ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿUbayd ibn ʿUmayr, from ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Khirrit, who had lived through the pre-Islamic period: “There was no clan of Quraysh that did not have a known gathering place in the Sacred Mosque where its members sat. Banu Bakr had a gathering place. While we were sitting in the mosque, a young boy approached.” He then related a story concerning the sanctity of the Kaʿba in the pre-Islamic period.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن عبيد بن عمير
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿUbayd ibn ʿUmayr

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الخزاعي والد طلحة الطلحات ذكره بن عبد البر وقال كان كاتب عمر على ديوان البصرة وقتل يوم الجمل ولا اعلم له صحبة قلت ووصفه بأنه كان كاتبا لعمر على ديوان البصرة ذكره بن دريد في أماليه يسنده إلى مجالد بن سعيد
records.english: of Khuza'a, father of Talha al-Talhat al-Talahat. Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr mentioned him and said: He was ʿUmar’s secretary for the register of Basra and was killed on the day of the Camel. I do not know of him having companionship. I say: Ibn Durayd, in his Amali, described him as ʿUmar’s secretary for the register of Basra, giving a chain to Mujalid ibn Saʿid.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: البولاني الطائي له إدراك وكان مع على بصفين ولما أراد عائذ بن قيس الجرمزي ان يأخذ الراية من عدي بن حاتم قام عبد الله بن خليفة فقال أليس كان عدي وافدكم إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وراسكم بالقادسية
records.english: of Bawlan and Tayy; he lived into the Islamic period and was with ʿAli at Siffin. When ʿAʾidh ibn Qays al-Jurmuzi wished to take the standard from ʿAdi ibn Hatim, ʿAbd Allah ibn Khalifa stood and said, “Was ʿAdi not the man you sent as your delegate to the Messenger of God ﷺ and your leader at al-Qadisiyya?”

names.arabic: عبد الله بن خليفة البولاني الطائي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Khalifa al-Bulani al-Taʾi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
العامري ذكره وثيمة في كتاب الردة وذكر عن بن إسحاق انه ممن ثبت على إسلامه وقام في ذلك خطيبا وله اشعار منها
لعمري لئن اجمعت عامر
على كفرها بعد اسلامها
ومناهم قرة الترهات
لقد رزئت عظم احلامها
أضاع الصلاة بنو عامر
واهلكها منع انعامها
وفي منعها الحق سفك الدماء
ووصم النساء لأيتامها واستدركه بن فتحون وقال قرة المذكور في هذا الشعر هو بن هبيرة اليشكري وكان زعيمهم في أيام الردة وذكره أبو عمر لكن لم ينبه على أمر ردته
records.english:
of Amir; Wathima mentioned him in the Book of the Ridda and reported from Ibn Ishaq that he was among those who remained firm in Islam and delivered an address concerning it. He composed verses, including:

By my life, if ʿAmir have united
upon unbelief after their Islam,
and Qurra has made vain fancies their desire,
then soundness of mind has suffered a grievous loss.
Banu ʿAmir have forsaken prayer,
and withholding their livestock has destroyed them.
In withholding the right that is due lie the shedding of blood
and the stigmatizing of women for their orphans.

Ibn Fathun added him and said: The Qurra mentioned in this verse was Ibn Hubayra al-Yashkuri, their leader during the apostasy. Abu ʿUmar mentioned him but did not call attention to the matter of his apostasy.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: مولى عثمان ذكره بن منده وقال أدرك النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قلت وله حديث عن عثمان في صفة الوضوء أخرجه الدارقطني ولم يسم فيه روى عنه محمد بن كعب وغيره وسماه بعضهم زيدا
records.english: a client of Uthman; Ibn Manda mentioned him and said that he lived into the time of the Prophet ﷺ. I say: He has a hadith from ʿUthman describing ablution. Al-Daraqutni cited it without naming him. Muhammad ibn Kaʿb and others transmitted from him. Some called him Zayd.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن الحارث بن عمرو بن الحارث بن ربيعة بن بلال بن أنس الله بن سعد العشيرة المذحجي له إدراك وشهد صفين مع علي قاله بن الكلبي ومن ولده عبد العزيز بن ثابت بن عبد الله بن ذباب له ذكر
records.english: son of al-Harith, son of Amr ibn al-Harith ibn Rabiʿa ibn Bilal ibn Anas Allah ibn Saʿd al-ʿAshira al-Madhhiji. He lived into the Islamic period and was present at Siffin with ʿAli, according to Ibn al-Kalbi. Among his descendants was ʿAbd al-ʿAziz ibn Thabit ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Dhubab, who is mentioned in the sources.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن ذباب بن الحارث بن عمرو بن الحارث بن ربيعة بن بلال بن أنس الله بن سعد العشيرة المذحجي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Dhubab ibn al-Harith ibn ʿAmr ibn al-Harith ibn Rabiʿa ibn Bilal ibn Anas Allah ibn Saʿd al-ʿAshira al-Madhhiji

names.arabic: عبد العزيز بن ثابت بن عبد الله بن ذباب
names.english: ʿAbd al-ʿAziz ibn Thabit ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn Dhubab

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن فراس اليماني مخضرم ذكره سيف بن عمر في الفتوح وأنشد له شعرا قاله في أمر الردة فمنه قوله سبحان ربي لا اله غيره رب العباد ورب من يتردد وكان اسمه قبل ان يسلم عبد العزي
records.english:
son of Firas al-Yamani. He lived in both the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods. Sayf ibn ʿUmar mentioned him in al-Futuh and quoted poetry that he composed concerning the apostasy, including:

Glory be to my Lord; there is no god but Him,
Lord of the servants and Lord of whoever comes and goes.

Before he embraced Islam, his name was ʿAbd al-ʿUzza.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن أبي رهم بن فراس اليماني
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Abi Rahm ibn Firas al-Yamani

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
بن لبيد بن صخر بن كنيف بن عمرو بن حي بن ربيعة بن سعد بن مالك بن سعد بن زيد مناة بن تميم التميمي السعدي يكنى أبا الشعثاء ويعرف بالعجاج الراجز المشهور وكان يقال له عبد الله الطويل وهو والد رؤبة بن العجاج الراجز المشهور ذكره المرزباني في معجم الشعراء وقال ولد في الجاهلية وقال أبو عبيدة كان في الجاهلية يرجز وعاش إلى خلافة الوليد بن عبد الملك وأنكر ذلك بن شبة وللعجاج رواية عن أبي هريرة قال المرزباني هو أول من رفع الرجز وجعل له أوائل وشبهه بالقصيدة قال ومما يستحسن له يصف ثدي الناقة إذا حلبت
كأن خلفيها إذا مادرا
جروا هراش حرشا فهرا
records.english:
son of Labid, son of Sakhr ibn Kunayf ibn ʿAmr ibn Hayy ibn Rabiʿa ibn Saʿd ibn Malik ibn Saʿd ibn Zayd Manat ibn Tamim al-Tamimi al-Saʿdi. His kunyah was Abu al-Shaʿthaʾ, and he was known as al-ʿAjjaj, the famous rajaz poet. He was also called ʿAbd Allah al-Tawil. He was the father of Ruʾba ibn al-ʿAjjaj, the famous rajaz poet. Al-Marzubani mentioned him in Muʿjam al-Shuʿaraʾ and said that he was born in the pre-Islamic period. Abu ʿUbayda said that he composed rajaz in the pre-Islamic period and lived until the caliphate of al-Walid ibn ʿAbd al-Malik. Ibn Shabba denied that. Al-ʿAjjaj transmitted from Abu Hurayra. Al-Marzubani said: He was the first to elevate rajaz, give its poems formal openings, and make it resemble the qasida. He said that among the verses of his that are admired are these, describing the rear teats of a she-camel when she gives milk:

Her two rear teats, when they pour forth,
are like two snarling pups, coarse and massive.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن رؤبة بن لبيد بن صخر بن كنيف بن عمرو بن حي بن ربيعة بن سعد بن مالك بن سعد بن زيد مناة بن تميم التميمي السعدي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Ruʾba ibn Labid ibn Sakhr ibn Kunayf ibn ʿAmr ibn Hayy ibn Rabiʿa ibn Saʿd ibn Malik ibn Saʿd ibn Zayd Manat ibn Tamim al-Tamimi al-Saʿdi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الكاتب قال بن عساكر أدرك عهد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وشهد فتح بعلبك وكتب الصلح لأهلها ذكره بن عائذ في المغازي عن الوليد بن مسلم عن إسماعيل بن عياش
records.english: the scribe; Ibn Asakir said that he lived in the time of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, witnessed the conquest of Baalbek, and wrote the treaty of peace for its people. Ibn ʿAʾidh mentioned him in al-Maghazi, from al-Walid ibn Muslim, from Ismaʿil ibn ʿAyyash.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن كيسان الدوسي ثم المحاربي من بني محارب بن دهمان بن منهب بن دوس الغساني ذكره بن الكلبي وقال كان في أول الإسلام
records.english: son of Kaysan al-Dawsi, then al-Muharibi, of Banu Muharib ibn Dahman ibn Munahhib ibn Daws al-Ghassani. Ibn al-Kalbi mentioned him and said that he lived in the early Islamic period.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن أبي زهير بن كيسان الدوسي ثم المحاربي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Abi Zuhayr ibn Kaysan al-Dawsi, then al-Muharibi

names.arabic: بني محارب بن دهمان بن منهب بن دوس
names.english: Banu Muharib ibn Dahman ibn Munahhib ibn Daws

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: منسوب إلى دريكة امرأة من بكر بن وائل فنسب ولده إليها يأتي خبره
records.english: The nisba refers to Durayka, a woman of Bakr ibn Wail to whom his descendants were ascribed. His report will appear below.

aliases: Abd Allah ibn Zayd al-Kindi al-Durayki
names.arabic: عبد الله بن زيد الكندي الدريكي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Zayd al-Kindi al-Durayki

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

title.arabic: عبد الله بن زيد الكندي الدريكي
title.english: Abd Allah ibn Zayd al-Kindi al-Durayki

records.arabic:
مخضرم ذكره وثيمة في كتاب الردة عن بن إسحاق قال لما ازمعت كندة على الردة انتزعوا من زياد بن لبيد عامل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم على اليمن ناقة وكان وسمها بميسم الصدقة فقام الوليد بن محصن فوعظهم فاخرجوه من بينهم فقام عبد الله بن زيد فقال أو كل من قال حقا اتهمتموه على أنفسكم ان رأيي والله رأى صاحبي فاخرجونا جميعا واشتد كلامه عليهم فطردوه فقال أبياتا منها
أردت ثمود بوادي الحجر ناقتهم
والحي من قابل في ناقة حوق
والحي من كندة صاروا بناقتهم
مثل الذين مضوا بالشؤم في النوق
ابعد دين تولى الله نصرته
من دين سوء ضعيف السر ممحوق ووقع نحو ذلك لعبد الله بن يزيد السكوني كما سيأتي
records.english:
He lived across the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods; Wathima mentioned him in the Book of the Ridda, from Ibn Ishaq, who said: When Kinda resolved upon apostasy, they took away from Ziyad ibn Labid—the official whom the Prophet ﷺ had appointed over Yemen—a she-camel that he had branded with the alms brand. Al-Walid ibn Mihsan stood and admonished them, but they expelled him from among them. ʿAbd Allah ibn Zayd stood and said, “Do you accuse everyone who speaks the truth of acting against you? By God, my opinion is the same as my companion’s, so expel us both.” He spoke sternly to them, and they drove him away. He recited verses, including:

Thamud in Wadi al-Hijr intended their she-camel,
and the clan, from qābil, regarding a she-camel of ḥawq [the readings qābil and ḥawq remain unresolved].
The clan of Kinda, with their she-camel, became
like those who passed before, ill-omened through she-camels.
After a religion whose victory God undertook,
do they turn to an evil faith, weak at heart and effaced?

Something similar occurred to ʿAbd Allah ibn Yazid al-Sakuni, as will appear below.

records.arabic: الهذلي أبو محمد أورده بن شاهين في الصحابة وقال روى عن عمر ومات سنة مائة
records.english: al-Hudhalī, Abū Muḥammad. Ibn Shahin included him among the Companions and said: He transmitted from ʿUmar and died in the year one hundred.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الحرشي شاعر فارس ذكره أبو علي الهجري وقال شهد الجسر في فتوح العراق فقطعت أصابع يده اليمنى فرثاها بأبيات وذكر المرزباني ترجمته ولم يعرف عن حاله بشيء الا انه قال صرع فارسا ودنا ليجيهز عليه فحذفه بالسيف فقطع بعض أصابعه فرثاها بأبيات قال فيها يمنى يدي غدت مني مفارقة اعزز على بها إذ بان فانصدعا ويل أمه فارسا زلت كتيبته حامي وقد ضيعوا الاحساب فارتجعا يمشي إلى مستميت مثله حنق حتى إذا امكنا سيفيهما قطعا فان يكن ارطبون الروم قطعها فقد تركت بها اوصاله قطعا وذكر قصة دعبل بن علي في طبقات الشعراء مطولة وذكر له قصة أخرى وهي ان امرأة من جيرانه عبث بها عطار يقال له فيروز فلما اضجرها قالت لو ان عبد الله بن سبرة بقربى ما طمعت في فبلغته مقالتها وهو في غزاة أرمينية فترك مركزه وقدم الشام فدخل على المرأة فاستخبرها فذكرت له قصتها فقال ارسلي اليه وكمن هو في جانب البيت فجاء فلما دخل عليها ودنا منها وثب عليه عبد الله بن سبرة فقتله ورجع إلى مكانه من غزاته ولم يعلم بذلك أحد
records.english:
al-Ḥarashī, a poet and horseman. Abu ʿAli al-Hajari mentioned him and said: He was present at the Bridge during the conquests of Iraq, where the fingers of his right hand were cut off. He lamented them in verses. Al-Marzubani gave his biography but knew nothing about his circumstances except that he said: He unhorsed a horseman and drew near to finish him, but the man struck at him with his sword and cut off some of his fingers. He lamented them in verses, saying:

My right hand has gone away, parting from me;
how grievous its loss when it separated and split.
Woe to his mother—what a horseman whose squadron slipped away!
He stood defending while they squandered honor and turned back.
He walks in rage toward one as bent on death as himself,
until, when they came within reach, their two swords cut.
If the Romans’ Artabun cut it off,
with it I left his limbs cut apart.

Diʿbil ibn ʿAli mentioned the story at length in Tabaqat al-Shuʿaraʾ. He also mentioned another story: A woman who was his neighbor was harassed by a perfumer called Fayruz. When the man exasperated her, she said, “If ʿAbd Allah ibn Sabra were near me, you would not have dared.” Her words reached him while he was on campaign in Armenia. He left his post and came to Syria. He entered upon the woman and asked her for the facts, and she told him her story. He said, “Send for him,” and concealed himself in a corner of the house. The man came. When he entered and drew near her, ʿAbd Allah ibn Sabra sprang upon him and killed him. He returned to his place on campaign, and no one learned of it.

records.arabic: الأزدي روى عن عمر خطبته بالجابية وروى عن أبي عبيدة روى عنه عبد الله بن شقيق قال البخاري لا يعرف له سماع من أبي عبيدة يعني لم يصرح بسماعه وقال المفضل الغلابي كان من أهل دمشق له شرف ورواية وذكر وخلط بن منده ترجمة هذا بترجمة عبد الله بن سراقة بن المعتمر العدوي المقدم ذكره في القسم الأول والذي يترجح التفرقة
records.english: al-Azdī. He transmitted ʿUmar’s sermon at al-Jabiya and also transmitted from Abu ʿUbayda. ʿAbd Allah ibn Shaqiq transmitted from him. Al-Bukhari said: No hearing by him from Abu ʿUbayda is known—meaning that he did not explicitly state that he heard him. Al-Mufaddal al-Ghallabi said: He was one of the people of Damascus and possessed distinction, transmitted reports, and was well known. Ibn Manda confused this man’s biography with that of ʿAbd Allah ibn Suraqa ibn al-Muʿtamir al-ʿAdawi, mentioned above in the first section. The more likely view is that they were distinct.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن سراقة بن المعتمر العدوي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Suraqa ibn al-Muʿtamir al-ʿAdawi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن خداش بن سعد بن عصبة بن جشم بن نمير بن عوف بن سعد بن حبيب بن دجاعة بن أنمار الأنماري له إدراك وكان ممن اختط بالكوفة لما اختطها المسلمون في خلافة عمر وانتقل ولده إلى البصرة فسكنوها ذكر ذلك بن الكلبي
records.english: ibn Khidāsh ibn Saʿd ibn ʿAsaba ibn Jusham ibn Numayr ibn ʿAwf ibn Saʿd ibn Habib ibn Dujaʿa ibn Anmar al-Anmari. He lived into the Islamic period and was among those who took a residential allotment in Kufa when the Muslims laid it out during ʿUmar’s caliphate. His descendants moved to Basra and settled there. Ibn al-Kalbi mentioned this.

aliases: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Saʿd ibn Rabīʿah
names.arabic: عبد الله بن سعد بن ربيعة بن خداش بن سعد بن عصبة بن جشم بن نمير بن عوف بن سعد بن حبيب بن دجاعة بن أنمار الأنماري
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Saʿd ibn Rabiʿa ibn Khidash ibn Saʿd ibn ʿAsaba ibn Jusham ibn Numayr ibn ʿAwf ibn Saʿd ibn Habib ibn Dujaʿa ibn Anmar al-Anmari

title.arabic: عبد الله بن سعد بن ربيعة
title.english: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Saʿd ibn Rabīʿah

records.arabic: بن وهب بن ربيعة بن معاوية الاكرمين الكندي له إدراك قال بن الكلبي كان من اشراف أهل البصرة وولاه على على السواد قال وكان أحد العشرين الذين جددوا حلف ربيعة واليمن ولابن أخيه سعدان وفادة
records.english: ibn Wahb ibn Rabīʿah ibn Muʿawiya al-Akramin al-Kindi. He lived into the Islamic period. Ibn al-Kalbi said: He was one of the nobles of Basra, and ʿAli appointed him over the Sawad. He said: He was one of the twenty who renewed the alliance of Rabiʿa and Yemen. His nephew Saʿdan came in a delegation.

aliases: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salamah ibn Abī al-Khayr
names.arabic: عبد الله بن سلمة بن أبي الخير بن وهب بن ربيعة بن معاوية الاكرمين الكندي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Salama ibn Abi al-Khayr ibn Wahb ibn Rabiʿa ibn Muʿawiya al-Akramin al-Kindi

title.arabic: عبد الله بن سلمة بن أبي الخير
title.english: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salamah ibn Abī al-Khayr

records.arabic: تابعي من أهل الكوفة قيل أدرك الجاهلية استدركه أبو موسى ولعبد الله بن سلمة رواية عن عمر وعلي وابن مسعود وغيرهم وروى عنه عمرو بن مرة قال بن نمير وجماعة لم يرو عنه غيره وقال الامام أحمد روى عنه أيضا أبو إسحاق ورد ذلك أبو أحمد الحاكم فأطال وحاصله ان الذي روى عنه أبو إسحاق آخر همداني واما المرادي فلم يرو عنه الا عمرو بن مرة كما قال يحيى بن معين وغيره
records.english: a Successor from Kūfah. It is said that he lived through the pre-Islamic period. Abu Musa added him. ʿAbd Allah ibn Salama transmitted from ʿUmar, ʿAli, Ibn Masʿud, and others. ʿAmr ibn Murra transmitted from him. Ibn Numayr and a group said that no one else transmitted from him. Imam Ahmad said that Abu Ishaq also transmitted from him. Abu Ahmad al-Hakim rejected this and discussed it at length. In sum, the man from whom Abu Ishaq transmitted was another person, a Hamdani. No one except ʿAmr ibn Murra transmitted from al-Muradi, as Yahya ibn Maʿin and others said.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
ذكره وثيمة في كتاب الردة وقال خرج وفد همدان لما بلغتهم وفاة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فدخلوا على أبي بكر الصديق فقال يا معشر قريش انكم لم تصابوا بالنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم دون سائر العرب لأنه لم يكن لاحد دون أحد غير انا معترفون للمهاجرين بفضل هجرتهم وللانصار بفضل نصرتهم وانشده
ان فقد النبي جزعنا اليوم
فدته الاسماع والابصار
ما اصيبت به الغداة قريش
لا ولا أفردت به الأنصار
فعليه السلام ما هبت الريح
ومدت جنح الظلام نوار وقد ذكرنا في الذي قبله قول من خلطه به وترجح ان الصواب التفرقة
records.english:
Wathīmah mentioned him in the Book of the Ridda and said: A delegation of Hamdan set out when news of the death of the Prophet ﷺ reached them. They entered upon Abu Bakr al-Siddiq. At this point the account gives the following address without naming its speaker: “People of Quraysh, the loss of the Prophet ﷺ did not befall you to the exclusion of the rest of the Arabs, for he belonged to no one people rather than another. Yet we acknowledge the merit of the Emigrants for their emigration and the merit of the Helpers for their support.” The account then introduces the following verses without securely identifying the reciter:

The loss of the Prophet has made us grieve today—
may hearing and sight be his ransom.
Quraysh were not alone afflicted by him this morning,
nor were the Helpers singled out by his loss.
So ﵇ as long as the wind blows
and the spreading wing of darkness is illuminated.

In the preceding entry we mentioned the view of one who confused this man with that one, and the correct view is more likely that they were distinct.

records.arabic: بن عمرو بن وهب بن الأفيصر بن مالك بن قحافة الخثعمي تقدم تمام نسبه في عون بن عميس في القسم الأول له إدراك ولا يبعد ان يكون له صحبة وله ولد اسمه مالك ولى الصوائف لمعاوية من سنة نيف وخمسين إلى ان مات في خلافة سليمان بن عبد الملك أربعين سنة ويقال انه كسر على قبره أربعون لواء ذكره بن الكلبي
records.english: ibn ʿAmr ibn Wahb ibn al-Ufaysir ibn Malik ibn Quhafa al-Khathʿami. His complete lineage was given above under ʿAwn ibn ʿUmays in the first section. He lived into the Islamic period, and it is not unlikely that he was a Companion. He had a son named Malik who commanded Muʿawiya’s summer campaigns from some year in the fifties until he died during the caliphate of Sulayman ibn ʿAbd al-Malik, a period of forty years. It is said that forty standards were broken over his grave. Ibn al-Kalbi mentioned him.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن سنان بن عمرو بن وهب بن الأفيصر بن مالك بن قحافة الخثعمي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Sinan ibn ʿAmr ibn Wahb ibn al-Ufaysir ibn Malik ibn Quhafa al-Khathʿami

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: من عمال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم على البحرين ذكره وثيمة في كتاب الردة عن بن إسحاق وانه كان ممن وفى لابان بن سعيد بن العاصي
records.english: one of the Prophet's صلى الله عليه وسلم officials over Bahrain. Wathima mentioned him in Kitab al-Ridda, from Ibn Ishaq, stating that he was among those who remained faithful to Aban ibn Saʿid ibn al-ʿAs.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
ويقال بن شداد التيمي ثم الشقري محضرم يقول في غزوة السند
الا هل اتى الفتيان بالسند مقدمي
على بطل قد هزه القوم مقدم
شددت له أسرى وايقنت انني
على طرف المهواة ان لم اصمم
records.english:
also said to be ibn Shaddād, al-Taymi, then al-Shaqri. He lived in both the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods. He said concerning the campaign of Sind:

Has word reached the young men in Sind of my advance
against a champion whom the advancing force had shaken?
I braced my strength against him, certain that I stood
at the brink of the abyss if I did not press on.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الخولاني له إدراك وذكره بن سعد في الطبقة الأولى من تابعي أهل الكوفة روى خيثمة بن عبد الرحمن عنه في صحيح مسلم عن عائشة حديثا وروى عنه أيضا سيئا موقوفا أخرجه سعيد بن منصور من طريق خيثمة عن عبد الله بن شهاب عن عمر قصة ووصلها بن أبي شيبة من طريق خيثمة قال اتى بشر بن مروان في خلع فلم يجزه فقال له عبد الله بن شهاب شهدت عمر اتى في خلع كان بين رجل وامرأة فأجازه وعلقه البخاري في كتاب الطلاق فقال وأجاز عمر الخلع دون الطلاق
records.english: al-Khawlānī. He lived into the Islamic period. Ibn Saʿd included him in the first generation of the Successors of Kufa. Khaythama ibn ʿAbd al-Rahman transmitted from him, from ʿAʾisha, a hadith found in Sahih Muslim. He also transmitted from him another report stopping at a Companion, which Saʿid ibn Mansur cited through Khaythama, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Shihab, from ʿUmar, as a story. Ibn Abi Shayba gave it with a connected chain through Khaythama, who said: A case of khulʿ divorce was brought to Bishr ibn Marwan, but he did not permit it. ʿAbd Allah ibn Shihab said to him, “I was present when ʿUmar was brought a khulʿ arrangement between a man and a woman, and he permitted it.” Al-Bukhari cited it without a full chain in the Book of Divorce, saying: “ʿUmar permitted khulʿ without pronouncement of divorce.”

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن ثور بن معاوية بن عبادة بن البكاء العامري ثم البكائي له إدراك وكان أحد الشهود يوم الجمل وشهد مشاهد على وهو جد زياد بن عبد الله راوي المغازي عن بن إسحاق ذكره بن الكلبي وقد تقدم ذكر عمه عبد الله بن ثور ويأتي ذكر عمه الأخر معاوية بن ثور
records.english: ibn Thawr ibn Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿUbada ibn al-Bakkaʾ al-ʿAmiri, then al-Bakkaʾi. He lived into the Islamic period and was one of the witnesses on the day of the Camel. He attended ʿAli’s battles. He was the grandfather of Ziyad ibn ʿAbd Allah, the transmitter of al-Maghazi from Ibn Ishaq. Ibn al-Kalbi mentioned him. His paternal uncle ʿAbd Allah ibn Thawr was mentioned above, and his other paternal uncle Muʿawiya ibn Thawr will be mentioned below.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن الطفيل بن ثور بن معاوية بن عبادة بن البكاء العامري ثم البكائي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Tufayl ibn Thawr ibn Muʿawiya ibn ʿUbada ibn al-Bakkaʾ al-ʿAmiri, then al-Bakkaʾi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: يأتي في عمرو بن عبد العزي
records.english: he will appear under ʿAmr ibn ʿAbd al-ʿUzzā.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
أحد بني نفيل ذكره وثيمة في الردة عن بن إسحاق قال لما بلغ قومه موت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فاجمعوا على منع الزكاة والمحاربة دون ذلك قام فخطبهم وذكرهم وكان شريفا فيهم فسبوه وخالفوه وكان شيخا كبيرا وكان القائم بامرهم في الردة قرة بن هبيرة ومن شعر عبد الله بن عتبة في ذلك
بني عامر لستم باخوف شوكة
ولا جمرة في الناس من غطفان
وليس لكم بالبحرين حابس طاقة
وليس لكم بالمسلمين يدان
records.english:
one of Banū Nufayl. Wathima mentioned him in al-Ridda, from Ibn Ishaq, who said: When news of the death of the Prophet ﷺ reached his people, they agreed to withhold the alms tax and to fight in defense of that position. He stood and addressed them, reminding and admonishing them. He was a noble among them, but they insulted and opposed him. He was a very old man. Qurra ibn Hubayra directed their affairs during the apostasy. Among ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿUtba’s verses about that were:

Banu ʿAmir, you are neither more fearsome in might
nor a hotter ember among the people than Ghatafan.
You have no power to hold out in Bahrain,
and you have no strength against the Muslims.

records.arabic: الجهني تقدم في الأول
records.english: al-Juhanī. He was discussed above in the first section.

records.arabic: هو بن الكواء مشهور بصحبة على يأتي
records.english: he is Ibn al-Kawwāʾ, well known for his companionship with ʿAli. He will appear below.

records.arabic: بن حصن بن قيس بن ثعلبة القيسي الكوفي يكنى أبا المهاجر من بني قيس بن ثعلبة أدرك الجاهلية قال سماك بن حرب سمعت عبد الله بن عميرة وكان قائد الأعشى في الجاهلية فذكر حديثا أخرجه بان منده من رواية روح بن عبادة عن شعبة عنه ورويناه في فوائد بن السماك من وجه آخر عن سماك عن أبي المهاجر عبد الله بن عميرة كان رجل من أهل صنعاء يسبق الحاج فذكر قصة لعمر في قتل الجماعة بالواحد
records.english: ibn Ḥiṣn ibn Qays ibn Thaʿlaba al-Qaysi al-Kufi, with the kunyah Abu al-Muhajir, of Banu Qays ibn Thaʿlaba. He lived through the pre-Islamic period. Simak ibn Harb said: I heard ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿUmayra, who had been al-Aʿsha’s guide in the pre-Islamic period; he then related a hadith. Ibn Manda cited it through Rawh ibn ʿUbada, from Shuʿba, from him. We also related it in Fawaʾid Ibn al-Sammak by another route, from Simak, from Abu al-Muhajir ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿUmayra: A man from Sanaʿa used to arrive ahead of the pilgrims; he then related an incident concerning ʿUmar’s execution of a group for killing a single person.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن عميرة بن حصن بن قيس بن ثعلبة القيسي الكوفي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿUmayra ibn Hisn ibn Qays ibn Thaʿlaba al-Qaysi al-Kufi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
بعين مهملة ثم نون مفتوحتين الضبي تقدم التنبيه عليه في الأول وانه شهد القادسية وذكره المرزباني في معجم الشعراء وساق نسبه إلى ضبة وقال انه رثى بسطام بن قيس الشيباني بقوله
افاتنة بنو زيد بن عمرو
ولا يوفى ببسطام قتيل
فخر على الألاءة لم يوسد
كأن جبينه سيف صقيل
فان يفجع عليه بنو أبيه
فقد فجعوا وفاتهم خليل
records.english:
with an undotted ʿayn followed by a nūn, both vowelled with fatḥah bearing fatha—al-Dabbi. Attention was called to him above in the first section, where it was stated that he was present at al-Qadisiyya. Al-Marzubani mentioned him in Muʿjam al-Shuʿaraʾ, traced his lineage to Dubba, and said that he elegized Bistam ibn Qays al-Shaybani with these words:

Were Banu Zayd ibn ʿAmr bereft of one who enthralled them?
No slain man can equal Bistam.
He fell upon the alaʾa, with no cushion beneath him,
as though his brow were a polished sword.
If the sons of his father grieve for him,
they truly have been bereaved, and a dear friend has departed them.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: حليف بني فزارة الحارثي له إدراك وكان معاوية يرسله في غزو البحر فغزا خمسين غزوة ما بين صائفة وشاتية لم ينكب فيها ولم يغرق معه أحد إلى ان قتل سنة ثلاث أو أربع وخمسين ذكره الطبري في تاريخه وكان أول ما غزا سنة سبع وعشرين
records.english: an ally of Banū Fazārah Fazara. He lived into the Islamic period. Muʿawiya used to send him on naval campaigns, and he undertook fifty campaigns, summer and winter, without suffering disaster and without anyone with him drowning, until he was killed in the year fifty-three or fifty-four. Al-Tabari mentioned him in his History. His first campaign was in the year twenty-seven.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الحمصي ذكره سيف في الفتوح وقال كان على كردوس يوم اليرموك ذكره بن سميع في الطبقة الأولى التي تلي الصحابة وذكره أبو زرعة الدمشقي فيمن تلقى عمر حين قدم الشام وذكر له قصة وقال العجلي تابعي ثقة وكلام بن عساكر يقتضي انه عبد الله بن أبي قيس المخرج حديثه عند مسلم والأربعة والصواب انه غيره
records.english: of Ḥimṣ. Sayf mentioned him in al-Futuh and said that he commanded a battalion on the day of al-Yarmuk. Ibn Sumayʿ included him in the first generation after the Companions. Abu Zurʿa al-Dimashqi included him among those who went out to meet ʿUmar when he came to Syria and related a story about him. Al-ʿIjli said: He was a trustworthy Successor. Ibn ʿAsakir’s words imply that he was ʿAbd Allah ibn Abi Qays, whose hadith is transmitted by Muslim and the four compilers, but the correct view is that he was someone else.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن قيس الهمداني الحمصي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Qays al-Hamdani al-Himsi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: أبو بحرية بفتح الموحدة وسكون المهملة وكسر الراء وتشديد المثناة التحتانية مشهور بكنيته التراغمي بفتح المثناة وكسر الغين المعجمة قال بن سميع أدرك الجاهلية صحب معاذا قلت وروى عنه وعن أبي عبيدة وجماعة وعنه يزيد بن قطيب وضمرة بن يحيى وخالد بن معدان وأبو بكر بن أبي مريم قال بن أبي خيثمة عن بن معين شامي ثقة وكذا قال العجلي ومات في خلافة الوليد وسيعاد في الكنى
records.english: Abū Baḥriyyah Bahriyya—with fatha on the baʾ, an unvoweled unpointed haʾ, kasra on the raʾ, and a doubled yaʾ. He is famous by his kunyah. Al-Taraghumi—with fatha on the taʾ and kasra on the dotted ghayn. Ibn Sumayʿ said: He lived through the pre-Islamic period and accompanied Muʿadh. I say: He transmitted from him, from Abu ʿUbayda, and from a group. Yazid ibn Qutayb, Damra ibn Yahya, Khalid ibn Maʿdan, and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Maryam transmitted from him. Ibn Abi Khaythama reported from Ibn Maʿin: He was a trustworthy Syrian. Al-ʿIjli said the same. He died during al-Walid’s caliphate and will be repeated under the kunyahs.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
بن حبيب بن عمرة بن ثابت بن مرة بن هلال بن فالج بن ذكوان بن ثعلبة بن بهثة بن سليم السلمي مخضرم شهد وقعة مرج الصفر ذكره المرزباني في معجمه وأنشد له
شهدت قبائل مالك وتغيبت
عنى عميرة يوم مرج الصفر وذكره أبو عبيد في كتاب النسب وما ابعد ان يكون له صحبة لكثرة من شهد الفتح من فرسان بني سليم
records.english:
ibn Ḥabīb ibn ʿAmrah ibn Thabit ibn Murra ibn Hilal ibn Falij ibn Dhakwan ibn Thaʿlaba ibn Buhtha ibn Sulaym al-Sulami. He lived in both the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods and was present at the Battle of Marj al-Suffar. Al-Marzubani mentioned him in his Muʿjam and quoted him:

I witnessed the tribes of Malik, while ʿUmayra
was absent from me on the day of Marj al-Suffar.

Abu ʿUbayd mentioned him in Kitab al-Nasab. It is by no means unlikely that he was a Companion, given the many horsemen of Banu Sulaym who were present at the Conquest.

names.arabic: عبد الله بن كامل بن حبيب بن عمرة بن ثابت بن مرة بن هلال بن فالج بن ذكوان بن ثعلبة بن بهثة بن سليم السلمي
names.english: ʿAbd Allah ibn Kamil ibn Habib ibn ʿAmra ibn Thabit ibn Murra ibn Hilal ibn Falij ibn Dhakwan ibn Thaʿlaba ibn Buhtha ibn Sulaym al-Sulami

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن شداد بن معاوية بن كعب بن معاوية بن عبادة بن عقيل بن كعب بن ربيعة بن عامر بن صعصعة والد ليلى الاخيلية الشاعرة المشهورة في زمن بني أمية قال المرزباني في ترجمة كعب بن حذيفة شاعر جاهلي وأنشد له شعرا قلت فيكون لولده عبد الله بن كعب إدراك فهو من أهل هذا القسم وولدت لعبد الله ليلى الاخيلية في خلافة عثمان
records.english: ibn Shaddād ibn Muʿāwiyah ibn Kaʿb ibn Muʿawiya ibn ʿUbada ibn ʿUqayl ibn Kaʿb ibn Rabiʿa ibn ʿAmir ibn Saʿsaʿa, father of Layla al-Akhyaliyya, the famous poet of the Umayyad period. Al-Marzubani said in the biography of Kaʿb ibn Hudhayfa that he was a poet of the pre-Islamic period, and he quoted poetry by him. I say: His son ʿAbd Allah ibn Kaʿb therefore lived into the Islamic period and belongs among the people of this section. Layla al-Akhyaliyya was born to ʿAbd Allah during ʿUthman’s caliphate.

aliases: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Kaʿb ibn Ḥudhayfah
names.arabic: عبد الله بن كعب بن حذيفة بن شداد بن معاوية بن كعب بن معاوية بن عبادة بن عقيل بن كعب بن ربيعة بن عامر بن صعصعة

records.arabic:
بفتح الكاف بعدها تحتانية ساكنة ثم مهملة مفتوحة ثم موحدة النهدي ذكره المرزباني في معجم الشعراء وقال كيسبة أمه ويقال اسمه عمرو وهو القائل لعمر بن الخطاب واستحمله في فلم يحمله
اقسم بالله أبو حفص عمر
ما مسها من نضب ولا دبر
فاغفر له اللهم ان كان فجر
وكان عمر نظر إلى راحلته لما ذكر انها وجعت فقال والله ما بها من قلبة فرد عليه فعلاه بالدرة وهرب وهو يقول ذلك فلما سمع عمر آخر قوله حمله وأعطاه وله قصة مع أبي موسى في فتح تستر وقيل ان كنيته أبو كيسبة وان عمر سمعه ينشدها فاستحلفه انه ما عرف بمكانه فحلف فحمله
records.english:
with fatḥah on the kāf, followed by a vowelless yāʾ, then an unpointed letter bearing fatha, then baʾ—al-Nahdi. Al-Marzubani mentioned him in Muʿjam al-Shuʿaraʾ and said that Kaysaba was his mother. It is also said that his name was ʿAmr. He is the one who said to ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab, after asking him for a mount and not receiving one:

Abu Hafs ʿUmar swears by God
that neither lesion nor saddle sore has touched her.
Forgive him, O God, if he has spoken wickedly.

ʿUmar had looked at his riding animal after he said that it was in pain and said, “By God, it has no defect.” The man answered him, so ʿUmar came down upon him with his staff. He fled while saying those words. When ʿUmar heard the last line, he gave him a mount and a gift. He also has an incident with Abu Musa at the conquest of Tustar. It is said instead that his kunyah was Abu Kaysaba, and that ʿUmar heard him reciting these lines and made him swear that he had not known ʿUmar was present. He swore, and ʿUmar gave him a mount.
