records.arabic: ذكره علي بن سعيد العسكري في الصحابة وهو وهم فإنه روى من طريق حجاج عن عبد الجبار بن وائل بن علقمة بن حجر عن أبيه عن جده قال رأيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يسجد على جبهته وانفه قال أبو موسى هذا خطأ وانما هو عن حجاج عن عبد الجبار بن وائل بن حجر عن أبيه قلت سبب الاشتباه ان عبد الجبار إنما سمع هذا الحديث من أخيه علقمة بن وائل عن أبيه فوقع في الإسناد تغيير استلزم ذكر علقمة بن حجر ولا وجود له وانما المعروف علقمة بن وائل بن حجر
records.english: ʿAlī ibn Saʿīd al-ʿAskarī listed him among the Companions, but this is an error. He narrated by way of Ḥajjāj, from ʿAbd al-Jabbār ibn Wāʾil ibn ʿAlqamah ibn Ḥujr, from his father, from his grandfather, who said, ‘I saw the Prophet ﷺ prostrate upon his forehead and nose.’ Abū Mūsā said, ‘This is an error. It is in fact from Ḥajjāj, from ʿAbd al-Jabbār ibn Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr, from his father.’ I say: the cause of the confusion is that ʿAbd al-Jabbār heard this report only from his brother ʿAlqamah ibn Wāʾil, from his father. A change occurred in the chain that resulted in the mention of ʿAlqamah ibn Ḥujr, who did not exist. The known person is ʿAlqamah ibn Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr.

names.arabic: عبد الجبار بن وائل بن علقمة بن حجر
names.english: ʿAbd al-Jabbār ibn Wāʾil ibn ʿAlqamah ibn Ḥujr

names.arabic: عبد الجبار بن وائل بن حجر
names.english: ʿAbd al-Jabbār ibn Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: مضى في الأول وان أبا حاتم قال لا صحبة له
records.english: He appeared in the first section, where Abū Ḥātim said that he was not a Companion.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: تقدم فيمن اسمه طلحة وان وقع عند بن قانع مصحفا
records.english: He appeared earlier among those named Ṭalḥah, although his name occurs in corrupted form in Ibn Qāniʿ.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره بن شاهين في الصحابة وروى من طريق بن يونس عن سماك بن علقمة عن أبيه قال بينما انا عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذ دخل رجل يقود رجلا بنسعة الحديث قال أبو موسى هذا خطأ وانما هو عن سماك عن علقمة عن أبيه فسماك هو بن حرب وعلقمة هو بن وائل بن حجر والصواب وائل بن حجر وقد حدث به بن أبي خيثمة من هذا الوجه على الصواب قلت وكذلك أخرجه مسلم وأبو داود والنسائي من طريق سماك
records.english: Ibn Shāhīn listed him among the Companions and narrated by way of Ibn Yūnus, from Simāk ibn ʿAlqamah, from his father, who said: ‘While I was with the Messenger of God ﷺ, a man entered leading another man by a leather thong,’ and he related the report. Abū Mūsā said, ‘This is an error. It is in fact from Simāk, from ʿAlqamah, from his father.’ Thus Simāk is Ibn Ḥarb, ʿAlqamah is Ibn Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr, and the correct Companion is Wāʾil ibn Ḥujr. Ibn Abī Khaythamah transmitted it correctly by this route. I say: Muslim, Abū Dāwūd, and al-Nasāʾī likewise transmitted it by way of Simāk.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره البزار في الصحابة فوهم فاخرج في الوحدان من طريق يزيد بن عبد الرحمن عن إسماعيل بن إبراهيم بن علي السلمي عن أبيه عن جده ان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال له الا ازوجك بنت ربيعة بن الحارث قال البزار لا نعلم روى عن السلمي الا هذا الحديث بهذا الإسناد انتهى ووقع عنده فيه تحريف وانما هو إسماعيل بن إبراهيم بن معاذ وقد تقدم في عباد على الصواب في القسم الأول
records.english: al-Bazzār listed him among the Companions and was mistaken. He transmitted in al-Wuḥdān by way of Yazīd ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm ibn ʿAlī al-Sulamī, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Prophet ﷺ said to him, ‘Shall I not marry you to the daughter of Rabīʿah ibn al-Ḥārith?’ Al-Bazzār said, ‘We know of no report narrated from al-Sulamī except this one with this chain.’ End quote. A corruption occurred in his text. The correct name is Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Muʿādh. It has already appeared correctly under ʿAbbād in the first section.

names.arabic: إسماعيل بن إبراهيم بن علي السلمي
names.english: Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm ibn ʿAlī al-Sulamī

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: استدركه الذهبي وعلم له علامة بقي بن مخلد وهو تصحيف وانما هو عمارة كما تقدم في الأول
records.english: al-Dhahabī added him as a supplement and marked him with the sign of Baqī ibn Makhlad, but the name is corrupted. He is in fact ʿUmārah, as previously stated in the first section.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: استدركه الذهبي أيضا وعزاه لبقي بن مخلد وهو تصحيف أيضا وانما هو عمارة بن زعكرة بزيادة زاي في أول اسم أبيه بغير ميم وقد مضى على الصواب
records.english: al-Dhahabī also added him as a supplement and attributed him to Baqī ibn Makhlad, but this too is a scribal corruption. He is in fact ʿUmārah ibn Zaʿkarah, with an additional zāy at the beginning of his father’s name and no mīm. He has already appeared correctly.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: في عمارة
records.english: See ʿUmārah.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: النسائي قال بن أبي حاتم روى عنه أبو عبد الرحمن الحبلي قلت لأبي له صحبة قال ما أدري كتبناه على الظن في الوحدان هكذا استدركه بن فتحون فصحف اسم أبيه وانما هو شبيب بالمعجمة وقد مضى على الصواب ورأيت بخط أبي علي البكري في الصحابة لابن حبان عمارة بن ثبيت بمثلثة ثم موحدة مصغرا آخره مثناة وهو تصحيف أيضا
records.english: al-Nasāʾī. Ibn Abī Ḥātim said, ‘Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Ḥubulī narrated from him. I asked my father, “Was he a Companion?” He replied, “I do not know. We included him conjecturally in al-Wuḥdān.”’ Ibn Fatḥūn added him as an omission in this form, but corrupted his father’s name. It is in fact Shabīb, with dotted shīn, and he has already appeared correctly. I saw in Abū ʿAlī al-Bakrī’s handwriting in Ibn Ḥibbān’s al-Ṣaḥābah: ‘ʿUmārah ibn Thubayt,’ with three-dotted thāʾ, followed by bāʾ, in the diminutive, and ending in tāʾ. This too is a scribal corruption.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: أورده جعفر المستغفري وعزاه ليحيى بن يونس الشيرازي قال جعفر وهو تابعي روى عن أبي هريرة قلت وبذلك ذكره البخاري وحديثه في مسند أبي يعلى وفي القطعيات وقال أبو حاتم مجهول وقال غيره عاش إلى خلافة عمر بن عبد العزيز
records.english: Jaʿfar al-Mustaghfirī included him and attributed the entry to Yaḥyā ibn Yūnus al-Shīrāzī. Jaʿfar said, ‘He was a Successor who narrated from Abū Hurayrah.’ I say: al-Bukhārī mentioned him as such. His report is in the Musnad of Abū Yaʿlā and in al-Qaṭʿiyyāt. Abū Ḥātim called him unknown. Another authority said that he lived until the caliphate of ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: رجل من أهل الشام تقدم ذكره في القسم الأول وأن الصواب أنه تابعي روى عن صحابي من خثعم لم يسم
records.english: a man from Syria. He was mentioned earlier in the first section, where it was stated that the correct view is that he was a Successor who narrated from an unnamed Companion of Khathʿam.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره جعفر أيضا وعزاه ليحيى بن يونس أورده أبو موسى قال وهو رجل من حمير تابعي ليست له صحبة قلت حديثه في سنن أبي داود عن عمته عن عائشة وقال أبو حاتم روى عن عائشة وقيل عن عمته عن عائشة
records.english: Jaʿfar also mentioned him and attributed the entry to Yaḥyā ibn Yūnus. Abū Mūsā cited him and said, ‘He was a man of Ḥimyar and a Successor, not a Companion.’ I say: his report is in Sunan Abī Dāwūd, from his paternal aunt, from ʿĀʾishah. Abū Ḥātim said, ‘He narrated from ʿĀʾishah,’ though it is also said, ‘from his paternal aunt, from ʿĀʾishah.’

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الليثي استدركه مغلطاي فيما قرأت بخطه على أسد الغابة فصحفه وانما هو عبادة وقد مضى على الصواب
records.english: al-Laythī. Mughlaṭāy added him as an omission in a note I read in his handwriting on Usd al-Ghābah, but he corrupted the name. It is in fact ʿUbādah, who has already appeared correctly.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن المغيرة بن عبد الله بن عمر بن مخزوم استدركه بن فتحون وعزاه لمقاتل فإنه قال في تفسيره في قوله تعالى ذرني ومن خلقت وحيدا قال نزلت في الوليد بن المغيرة كان له من الولد سبعة اسلم ثلاثة خالد وهشام وعمارة كذا قال وأورده الثعلبي في تفسيره عن مقاتل والصواب خالد وهشام والوليد فاما عمارة فإنه مات كافرا لان قريشا بعثوه إلى النجاشي فجرت له معه قصة فاصيب بعقله وهام مع الوحش وقد بينت انه ممن دعا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عليهم من قريش لما وضع عقبة بن أبي معيط سلى الجزور على ظهره وهو يصلى
records.english: son of al-Mughīrah, son of ʿAbd Allāh, son of ʿUmar, son of Makhzūm. Ibn Fatḥūn added him as an omission and attributed the entry to Muqātil, who said in his commentary on the saying of God تعالى, ‘Leave Me with the one whom I created alone’: ‘It was revealed concerning al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīrah. He had seven sons, three of whom embraced Islam: Khālid, Hishām, and ʿUmārah.’ This is what he said, and al-Thaʿlabī cited it in his commentary from Muqātil. The correct three are Khālid, Hishām, and al-Walīd. As for ʿUmārah, he died an unbeliever. Quraysh had sent him to the Negus, where an incident befell him: his mind was afflicted, and he wandered with the wild animals. I have explained that he was among the members of Quraysh against whom the Prophet ﷺ supplicated when ʿUqbah ibn Abī Muʿayṭ placed the entrails of a slaughtered camel on his back while he was praying.

names.arabic: عمارة بن الوليد بن المغيرة بن عبد الله بن عمر بن مخزوم
names.english: ʿUmārah ibn al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīrah ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar ibn Makhzūm

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: صاحب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال لقد رأيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وما يريد ان يشير بأصبعه فرق بن شاهين بين هذا وبين عمارة بن رويبة فوهم فأنه هو والحديث حديثه
records.english: a Companion of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم. He said, ‘I certainly saw the Prophet ﷺ, and he would not point with his finger.’ Ibn Shāhīn distinguished this man from ʿUmārah ibn Ruʾaybah, but erred. He is the same man, and the report is his.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره الباوردي في الصحابة واستدركه بن فتحون وهو وهم فإنه اخرج من طريق مسعود بن سعد عن عطاء بن السائب عن بن عمارة عن أبيه قال رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بعرفة واقفا الحديث والصواب عن عطاء بن السائب عن بن عباد عن أبيه فابن عباد هو ربيعة وقد مضى
records.english: al-Bāwardī listed him among the Companions, and Ibn Fatḥūn added him as an omission, but it is an error. Al-Bāwardī transmitted by way of Masʿūd ibn Saʿd, from ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib, from Ibn ʿUmārah, from his father, who said, ‘I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ standing at ʿArafah,’ and the rest of the report. The correct chain is from ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib, from Ibn ʿAbbād, from his father. Ibn ʿAbbād is Rabīʿah, who has already appeared.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره بن عبد البر قال بن فتحون وهو وهم
records.english: Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr mentioned him. Ibn Fatḥūn said, ‘It is an error.’

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن أحيحة الأنصاري قيل له صحبة كذا استدركه صاحب التجريد فصحفه وانما هو عمرو كما مضى على الصواب
records.english: ibn Uḥayḥah al-Anṣārī. It is said that he was a Companion. The author of al-Tajrīd added him as an omission in this form, but corrupted the name. He is in fact ʿAmr, as previously stated correctly.

names.arabic: عمر بن بليل بن أحيحة الأنصاري
names.english: ʿUmar ibn Bulayl ibn Uḥayḥah al-Anṣārī

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: استدركه بن الأثير على الاستيعاب لان صاحب الاستيعاب قال في ترجمة ثابت بن وقش شهد هو وابناه عمرو وعمر أحدا والمعروف ان اسم ولديه سلمة وعمر وكذلك ترحمة صاحب الاستيعاب في ترجمة سلمة وكذلك ذكره العدوي في نسب الأنصار
records.english: Ibn al-Athīr added him to al-Istīʿāb because the author of al-Istīʿāb said in the biography of Thābit ibn Waqsh, ‘He and his two sons, ʿAmr and ʿUmar, were present at Uḥud.’ What is known is that his two sons were named Salamah and ʿUmar. The author of al-Istīʿāb himself gives it that way in the biography of Salamah, and al-ʿAdawī likewise mentioned it in Nasab al-Anṣār.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: أرسل شيئا فذكره بعضهم وقد ذكره بن حبان في ثقات التابعين وقال روى عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مرسلا وروى عنه كهمس بن الحسن
records.english: he transmitted something without a complete chain, so some mentioned him among the Companions. Ibn Ḥibbān mentioned him among the trustworthy Successors and said, ‘He narrated from the Prophet ﷺ without naming the intermediary, and Kahmas ibn al-Ḥasan narrated from him.’

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic:
الخزاعي ذكره بن منده قال وقيل عمرو بن سالم وهو وافد خزاعة ثم ذكر من حديث بن عباس ان عمر بن سالم الخزاعي اتى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فأنشده
اللهم اني ناشد محمدا
الأبيات قال أبو نعيم كذا أخرجه ولم يختلف في انه عمرو يعني بفتح العين قال بن الأثير قول أبي نعيم صحيح وقول بن منده وهم وتصحيف واختصره الذهبي اختصارا عجيبا فقال ما نصه عمر بن سالم الخزاعي وقيل عمرو وافد خزاعة والأصح عمر كذا في النسخة وأظن الواو سقطت ليلتئم كلامه بأصله
records.english: al-Khuzāʿī. Ibn Mandah mentioned him and said, ‘He is also called ʿAmr ibn Sālim, and he was the envoy of Khuzāʿah.’ He then cited from the report of Ibn ʿAbbās that ʿUmar ibn Sālim al-Khuzāʿī came to the Prophet ﷺ and recited to him: ‘O God, I adjure Muḥammad…’ and the remaining verses. Abū Nuʿaym said, ‘This is how he transmitted it, though there is no disagreement that he is ʿAmr’—meaning with fatḥah on the ʿayn. Ibn al-Athīr said, ‘Abū Nuʿaym’s statement is correct, while Ibn Mandah’s is an error and a scribal corruption.’ Al-Dhahabī abridged it in a remarkable manner, saying verbatim, ‘ʿUmar ibn Sālim al-Khuzāʿī, also said to be ʿAmr, the envoy of Khuzāʿah; the more correct is ʿUmar.’ This is how it stands in the copy. I think the wāw fell from the text, for adding it makes his statement agree with its source.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن المعتمر ذكره أبو عمر فصحفه والصواب عمرو وقد نبه على ذلك بن فتحون وقال ذكره أبو عمر في ترجمة أخيه عبد الله علي الصواب
records.english: ibn al-Muʿtamir. Abū ʿUmar mentioned him but corrupted the name. The correct name is ʿAmr. Ibn Fatḥūn pointed this out and said, ‘Abū ʿUmar mentioned him correctly in the biography of his brother ʿAbd Allāh.’

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: السلمي ذكره مطين في الوحدان من طريق مغازي الواقدي فقال عن زياد بن عمر بن سعد حدثني جدي وأبي وكانا شهدا حنينا فذكر قصة محلم بن جثامة وتبعه أبو نعيم فقال فيه نظر وذكره أبو موسى فلم ينبه على وهمه والصواب ضميرة بن سعد كذا أخرجه أبو داود في السنن على الصواب بهذا السند والمتن
records.english: al-Sulamī. Muṭayyan mentioned him in al-Wuḥdān by way of al-Wāqidī’s Maghāzī, saying: ‘from Ziyād ibn ʿUmar ibn Saʿd: my grandfather and my father, both of whom witnessed Ḥunayn, related to me,’ and he recounted the story of Muḥallim ibn Jaththāmah. Abū Nuʿaym followed him but said, ‘There is some question concerning him.’ Abū Mūsā mentioned him without pointing out the error. The correct name is Ḍumayrah ibn Saʿd. Abū Dāwūd transmitted it correctly in al-Sunan with this chain and text.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الزهري ذكره بن فتحون في الذيل مستأنسا بما ذكره أبو عروبة من طريق سعيد بن بزيع عن بن إسحاق قال كتب عمر بن الخطاب إلى سعد بن أبي وقاص ان الله قد فتح الشام والعراق فابعث من قبلك جندا إلى الجزيرة فبعث جيشا مع عياض بن غنم وبعث معه عمر بن سعد وهو غلام حديث السن وكذا رواه يعقوب بن سفيان والطبري من طريق سلمة بن الفضل عن بن إسحاق قال وكان ذلك سنة تسع عشرة قال بن فتحون من كان في هذه السنة يبعث في الجيوش فقد كان لا محالة مولودا في عهد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال بن عساكر هذا يدل على انه ولد في عهد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال بن فتحون وقد عارض هذا ما هو أقوى منه ففي الصحيحين من طريق بن شهاب عن عامر بن سعد عن أبيه قال مرضت بمكة فعادني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقلت يا رسول الله اني ذو مال لا يرثني الا ابنة الحديث ففي رواية مالك والجمهور ان ذلك كان في حجة الوداع وفي رواية بن عيينة في الفتح قلت قد جزم امام المحدثين يحيى بن معين بان عمر بن سعد ولد في السنة التي مات فيها عمر بن الخطاب ذكر ذلك بن أبي خيثمة في تاريخه عن يحيى وذكر سيف في الردة ان سعدا كانت عنده يسرى بنت قيس بن أبي الكيسم من كندة في زمان الردة فولدت له عمر بن سعد
records.english: al-Zuhrī. Ibn Fatḥūn mentioned him in al-Dhayl, finding support in what Abū ʿArūbah cited by way of Saʿīd ibn Buzayʿ, from Ibn Isḥāq, who said: ‘ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb wrote to Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ, “God has opened Syria and Iraq, so send an army from those with you to al-Jazīrah.” He sent an army with ʿIyāḍ ibn Ghanm and sent with him ʿUmar ibn Saʿd, who was a young boy.’ Yaʿqūb ibn Sufyān and al-Ṭabarī likewise narrated it by way of Salamah ibn al-Faḍl, from Ibn Isḥāq, who said that this was in the year nineteen. Ibn Fatḥūn said, ‘Anyone who was sent with armies in that year must certainly have been born during the time of the Prophet ﷺ.’ Ibn ʿAsākir said, ‘This indicates that he was born during the time of the Prophet ﷺ.’ Ibn Fatḥūn said, ‘Something stronger contradicts this. In the two Ṣaḥīḥ collections, by way of Ibn Shihāb, from ʿĀmir ibn Saʿd, from his father, who said, “I fell ill in Mecca, and the Messenger of God ﷺ visited me. I said, ‘O Messenger of God, I possess wealth and have no heir except one daughter,’”’ and the rest of the report. In the narration of Mālik and the majority, that occurred during the Farewell Pilgrimage; in Ibn ʿUyaynah’s narration, it occurred in the year of the Conquest. I say: Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, the leading scholar of tradition, stated decisively that ʿUmar ibn Saʿd was born in the year in which ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb died. Ibn Abī Khaythamah mentioned this in his history from Yaḥyā. Sayf stated in al-Riddah that during the time of the apostasy wars Saʿd was married to Yusrā bint Qays ibn Abī al-Kaysam of Kindah, and she bore him ʿUmar ibn Saʿd.

names.arabic: عمر بن سعد بن أبي وقاص الزهري
names.english: ʿUmar ibn Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ al-Zuhrī

names.arabic: يسرى بنت قيس بن أبي الكيسم من كندة
names.english: Yusrā bint Qays ibn Abī al-Kaysam of Kindah

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

title.arabic: عمر بن سعد بن أبي وقاص
title.english: ʿUmar ibn Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ

records.arabic: السلمي روى بن السكن وابن منده من طريق عبد الحميد بن سلمة عن أبيه عن عمر بن عامر السلمي انه سأل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن الصلاة فقال إذا صليت الصبح فأمسك عن الصلاة حتى تطلع الشمس فانها تطلع بين قرني شيطان الحديث قال أبو نعيم غلط فيه بعض الرواة وانما هو عمرو بن عبسة السلمي وكذلك أخرجه بن السني من الوجه الذي أخرجه منه بن السكن فقال عمرو بن عبسة
records.english: al-Sulamī. Ibn al-Sakan and Ibn Mandah narrated by way of ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn Salamah, from his father, from ʿUmar ibn ʿĀmir al-Sulamī, that he asked the Messenger of God ﷺ about prayer. He replied, ‘When you have performed the dawn prayer, refrain from praying until the sun rises, for it rises between the two horns of a devil,’ and the rest of the report. Abū Nuʿaym said, ‘One of the narrators erred concerning him. He is in fact ʿAmr ibn ʿAbasah al-Sulamī.’ Ibn al-Sunnī likewise transmitted it by the same route used by Ibn al-Sakan and said ‘ʿAmr ibn ʿAbasah.’

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن أبي زياد تابعي روى عن أنس غلط بعض الرواة فذكره في الصحابة قال بن منده لا يصح وقال بن أبي حاتم عمر بن عبيد الله بن أبي زياد روى موسى النصيبي عن أبي ضمرة عن الحارث بن أبي ذباب عن عمر بن عبيد الله ان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم صلى بهم المغرب قال فسألت أبي عنه فقال أخطأ فيه موسى وانما هو عن عمر بن عبيد الله ان أنس بن مالك صلى بهم قال وعمر تابعي ووقع في كتاب بن الأثير عمر بن عبيد الله بن أبي زكريا والله اعلم
records.english: ibn Abī Ziyād. He was a Successor who narrated from Anas. One of the narrators erred and mentioned him among the Companions. Ibn Mandah said, ‘It is not sound.’ Ibn Abī Ḥātim said, ‘ʿUmar ibn ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Ziyād: Mūsā al-Naṣībī narrated from Abū Ḍamrah, from al-Ḥārith ibn Abī Dhubāb, from ʿUmar ibn ʿUbayd Allāh, that the Prophet ﷺ led them in the sunset prayer.’ He continued: ‘I asked my father about it, and he said, “Mūsā erred. It is in fact from ʿUmar ibn ʿUbayd Allāh that Anas ibn Mālik led them in prayer.” He said, “ʿUmar was a Successor.”’ In Ibn al-Athīr’s book, the name occurs as ʿUmar ibn ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Zakariyyā. والله أعلم

names.arabic: عمر بن عبيد الله بن أبي زياد
names.english: ʿUmar ibn ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Ziyād

names.arabic: عمر بن عبيد الله بن أبي زكريا
names.english: ʿUmar ibn ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Zakariyyā

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: حليف بني عامر بن لؤي ذكره بن شاهين وروى من طريق الواقدي قال عمر بن عوف يماني حليف بني عامر بن لؤي واسلم قديما وصحب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وروى عنه قلت والصواب انه عمرو بن عوف بفتح العين
records.english: an ally of Banū ʿĀmir ibn Luʾayy. Ibn Shāhīn mentioned him and narrated by way of al-Wāqidī, who said, ‘ʿUmar ibn ʿAwf was a Yemeni and an ally of the Banū ʿĀmir ibn Luʾayy. He embraced Islam early, accompanied the Prophet ﷺ, and narrated from him.’ I say: the correct name is ʿAmr ibn ʿAwf, with fatḥah on the ʿayn.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره بن منده واعاده في عمرو على الصواب وقد تقدم
records.english: Ibn Mandah mentioned him, then repeated his entry correctly under ʿAmr. He has already appeared.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: العامري صوابه أبي بن مالك وقد تقدم
records.english: al-ʿĀmirī. The correct name is Ubayy ibn Mālik, who has already appeared.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بفتح ثم سكون بن أبي الأسد وهم فيه بعض الرواة قال الحسن بن سفيان حدثنا محمد بن حرب المروزي حدثنا محمد بن بشر عن عبيد الله بن عمر عن الزهري عن عمرو بن أبي الأسد قال رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلى في ثوب واحد واضعا طرفيه على عاتقيه قال أبو موسى في الذيل رواه أبو كريب وعلي بن حرب وغيرهما عن محمد بن بشر هكذا وقال الدارقطني في الإفراد تفرد به محمد بن بشر هكذا والصواب ما رواه أبو أسامة وغيره عن عبيد الله بن عمر عن الزهري عن سعيد بن المسيب عن عمرو بن أبي سلمة بن عبد الأسد قلت كذا أورده بن خزيمة وابن حبان من طريق أبي أسامة وزعم بن الأثير ان أبا نعيم سماه عمرو بن الأسود في هذا الإسناد والذي رأيته في المعرفة لأبي نعيم عمرو بن أبي الأسد والله اعلم
records.english: with fatḥah then sukūn, ibn Abī al-Asad. Some narrators erred concerning him. Al-Ḥasan ibn Sufyān said: Muḥammad ibn Ḥarb al-Marwazī related to us; Muḥammad ibn Bishr related to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Asad, who said, ‘I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ praying in a single garment, with its two ends placed over his shoulders.’ Abū Mūsā said in al-Dhayl, ‘Abū Kurayb, ʿAlī ibn Ḥarb, and others narrated it from Muḥammad ibn Bishr in this form.’ Al-Dāraquṭnī said in al-Afrād, ‘Muḥammad ibn Bishr alone narrated it in this form.’ The correct version is what Abū Usāmah and others narrated from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, from al-Zuhrī, from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab, from ʿAmr ibn Abī Salamah ibn ʿAbd al-Asad. I say: Ibn Khuzaymah and Ibn Ḥibbān cited it in this form by way of Abū Usāmah. Ibn al-Athīr claimed that Abū Nuʿaym called him ʿAmr ibn al-Aswad in this chain, but what I saw in Abū Nuʿaym’s al-Maʿrifah is ‘ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Asad.’ والله أعلم

names.arabic: عمرو بن أبي سلمة بن عبد الأسد
names.english: ʿAmr ibn Abī Salamah ibn ʿAbd al-Asad

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن أبي أوس الثقفي تابعي مشهور حديثه في الكتب الستة وذكره الجمهور في التابعين وذكره الطبراني وابن منده وطائفة في الصحابة بسبب الحديث الذي أخرجوه من طريق الوليد بن مسلم عن عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن الطائفي عن عثمان بن عمرو بن أوس عن أبيه قال قدمت على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في وفد ثقيف والمشهور ما رواه الحفاظ عن الطائفي المذكور عن عثمان وهو بن عبد الله بن أوس عن عمرو بن أوس عن أبيه فوقع في رواية الوليد ابدال عن فصارت بن فالصواب عن عثمان عن عمرو عن أبيه والحديث حديث أوس وقد وقع فيه خطأ آخر بينته في ترجمة عبد الله بن أوس
records.english: ibn Abī Aws al-Thaqafī. He was a well-known Successor whose reports are in the six books. The majority mentioned him among the Successors, while al-Ṭabarānī, Ibn Mandah, and a group mentioned him among the Companions because of the report they transmitted by way of al-Walīd ibn Muslim, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Ṭāʾifī, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAmr ibn Aws, from his father, who said, ‘I came to the Prophet ﷺ with the delegation of Thaqīf.’ The well-known version is what the reliable transmitters narrated from the aforementioned al-Ṭāʾifī, from ʿUthmān—namely Ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aws—from ʿAmr ibn Aws, from his father. In al-Walīd’s narration, the word ‘from’ was changed to ‘son of.’ The correct chain is therefore ‘from ʿUthmān, from ʿAmr, from his father,’ and the report is the report of Aws. Another error occurred in it, which I explained in the biography of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aws.

names.arabic: عمرو بن أوس بن أبي أوس الثقفي
names.english: ʿAmr ibn Aws ibn Abī Aws al-Thaqafī

names.arabic: عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن الطائفي
names.english: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Ṭāʾifī

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الوادعي أبو عطية تابعي مشهور سمع عليا وابن مسعود وأرسل حديثا فذكره علي بن سعيد العسكري في الصحابة فروى من طريق سفيان عن علي بن الأحمر عن أبي عطية الوادعي قال نظر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى نساء في جنازة فقال ارجعن مأزورات قلت وهذا الحديث معروف من رواية
records.english: al-Wādiʿī, Abū ʿAṭiyyah. He was a well-known Successor who heard from ʿAlī and Ibn Masʿūd. He transmitted a report without naming the Companion, so ʿAlī ibn Saʿīd al-ʿAskarī mentioned him among the Companions. He narrated by way of Sufyān, from ʿAlī ibn al-Aḥmar, from Abū ʿAṭiyyah al-Wādiʿī, who said: ‘The Prophet ﷺ saw some women in a funeral procession and said, “Go back, bearing sin.”’ I say: this report is known from the narration of—

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: هو عمرو بن الحارث بن أبي ضرار ذكره بن منده وأبو نعيم في بن المصطلق واستدركه أبو موسى في بن أبي ضرار وابن أبي ضرار هو الصحيح والمصطلق جده الأعلى فهو واحد لامعي لاستدراكه
records.english: he is ʿAmr ibn al-Ḥārith ibn Abī Ḍirār. Ibn Mandah and Abū Nuʿaym mentioned him under ‘Ibn al-Muṣṭaliq,’ while Abū Mūsā added him as an omission under ‘Ibn Abī Ḍirār.’ ‘Ibn Abī Ḍirār’ is correct, and al-Muṣṭaliq is his remote ancestor. He is one man, so there is no basis for adding him as an omission.

names.arabic: عمرو بن الحارث بن أبي ضرار
names.english: ʿAmr ibn al-Ḥārith ibn Abī Ḍirār

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الأنصاري ترجم له النسائي في كتاب المناقب فذكره بعد سلمان الفارسي وقبل خالد بن الوليد وساق من طريق عمرو بن دينار عن جابر رفعه جزاكم الله معشر الأنصار خيرا لا سيما آل عمرو بن حرام وسعد بن عبادة قلت والمراد بآل عمرو ولده عبد الله والد جابر وابنه جابر وعماته واخواته واما عمرو بن حرام جد جابر فلم يدرك الإسلام وكأنه لما قرنه بسعد بن عبادة ظن انه صحابي كسعد وليس كذلك وينبغي ان يقرأ سعد بالرفع عطفا على آل لا بالجر عطفا على عمرو وابنه والله اعلم
records.english: al-Anṣārī. Al-Nasāʾī gave him a biography in Kitāb al-Manāqib, mentioning him after Salmān al-Fārisī and before Khālid ibn al-Walīd. He cited by way of ʿAmr ibn Dīnār, from Jābir, who raised it to the Prophet: ‘May God reward you, company of the Anṣār, with good—especially the family of ʿAmr ibn Ḥarām and Saʿd ibn ʿUbādah.’ I say: ‘the family of ʿAmr’ means his son ʿAbd Allāh, Jābir’s father; his grandson Jābir; and Jābir’s paternal aunts and sisters. As for ʿAmr ibn Ḥarām, Jābir’s grandfather, he did not live into Islam. It seems that when al-Nasāʾī paired him with Saʿd ibn ʿUbādah, someone assumed that he was a Companion like Saʿd, but he was not. Saʿd should be read in the nominative as coordinated with ‘family,’ not in the genitive as coordinated with ʿAmr and his son. والله أعلم

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الليثي ذكره بن منده من طريق الفريابي عن بن أبي ذئب عن الحارث بن الحكم عنه قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ليس للنساء سراة الطريق قال أبو نعيم لا يصح له صحبة والصواب أبو عمرو بن حماس وهو تابعي
records.english: al-Laythī. Ibn Mandah mentioned him by way of al-Firyābī, from Ibn Abī Dhiʾb, from al-Ḥārith ibn al-Ḥakam, from him, who said: the Messenger of God ﷺ said, ‘Women are not entitled to the middle of the road.’ Abū Nuʿaym said, ‘It is not sound that he was a Companion. The correct person is Abū ʿAmr ibn Ḥammās, who was a Successor.’

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الأوسي ذكر أبو موسى عن جعفر انه قال شهد بدرا قلت وقد صحف أباه وانما هو الجلاس بالجيم وقد بيناه على الصواب
records.english: al-Awsī. Abū Mūsā related from Jaʿfar that he said, ‘He was present at Badr.’ I say: he corrupted his father’s name. It is in fact al-Jallās, with jīm, as we have explained correctly.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره أبو موسى تبعا لسعيد الطالقاني وأورد من طريق هلال بن أبي هلال واسم أبي هلال عامر عن عمرو بن رافع قال رأيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يخطب بعد الظهر يوم النحر الحديث والصواب عن رافع بن عمرو وقلبه على بن مجاهد الراوي عن هلال وقال مرة عن هلال عن عمرو بن رافع عن أبيه وهو خطأ أيضا وانما اختلف على هلال بن عامر فقيل عن هلال عن رافع بن عمرو وقيل عن هلال عن أبيه ولا ذكر لرافع ولا لعمرو فيه وقد بينته في عامر بن عمرو المزني وقد رواه وكيع ومروان بن معاوية وغيرهما عن هلال عن رافع بن عمرو وهو المحفوظ
records.english: Abū Mūsā mentioned him, following Saʿīd al-Ṭālaqānī, and cited by way of Hilāl ibn Abī Hilāl—Abū Hilāl’s name was ʿĀmir—from ʿAmr ibn Rāfiʿ, who said, ‘I saw the Prophet ﷺ delivering a sermon after noon on the Day of Sacrifice,’ and the rest of the report. The correct name is Rāfiʿ ibn ʿAmr. ʿAlī ibn Mujāhid, the narrator from Hilāl, reversed it. On another occasion he said, ‘from Hilāl, from ʿAmr ibn Rāfiʿ, from his father,’ which is also an error. There was disagreement over the report from Hilāl ibn ʿĀmir. One version says, ‘from Hilāl, from Rāfiʿ ibn ʿAmr,’ while another says, ‘from Hilāl, from his father,’ with no mention of Rāfiʿ or ʿAmr. I have explained it under ʿĀmir ibn ʿAmr al-Muzanī. Wakīʿ, Marwān ibn Muʿāwiyah, and others narrated it from Hilāl, from Rāfiʿ ibn ʿAmr, and that is the preserved version.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره بن قانع وهو خطأ نشأ عن سقط روى بن قانع من طريق جعفر بن سليمان عن خالد بن سلمة عن سعيد بن عمرو بن زرارة عن أبيه قال كنت جالسا عند النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فتلا هذه الآية ان المجرمين في ضلال وسعر قال نزلت في أناس يكذبون بالقدر في أخر الزمان وقد أخرجه بن شاهين وابن مردويه في التفسير وغيرهما من طريق جعفر بن سليمان عن خالد عن سعيد بن عمرو بن جعدة عن عمرو بن زرارة عن أبيه وأخرجاه من وجه آخر عن خالد بن سلمة كذلك فسقط لابن قانع من عمرو إلى عمرو فتركب منه ان الصحبة لعمرو بن زرارة وليس كذلك
records.english: Ibn Qāniʿ mentioned him, but this is an error arising from an omission. Ibn Qāniʿ narrated by way of Jaʿfar ibn Sulaymān, from Khālid ibn Salamah, from Saʿīd ibn ʿAmr ibn Zurārah, from his father, who said, ‘I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ when he recited this verse: “Indeed, the criminals are in error and blazing fire.” He said, “It was revealed concerning people at the end of time who deny divine predestination.”’ Ibn Shāhīn, Ibn Mardawayh in his commentary, and others transmitted it by way of Jaʿfar ibn Sulaymān, from Khālid, from Saʿīd ibn ʿAmr ibn Jaʿdah, from ʿAmr ibn Zurārah, from his father. They also transmitted it by another route from Khālid ibn Salamah in that form. The names between the first ʿAmr and the second ʿAmr fell from Ibn Qāniʿ’s text, producing the false impression that ʿAmr ibn Zurārah was the Companion, which is not so.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن سالم الخزاعي استدركه بن فتحون على الاستيعاب وحكى عن الطبري انه كان أحد من يحمل ألوية خزاعة يوم الفتح قلت ولا معنى لاستدراكه فإنه هو عمرو بن سالم بن كلثوم الخزاعي الذي ذكره أبو عمر قال بن الأثير اخرج أبو موسى هذه الترجمة مستدركا على بن منده وعزاه لابن شاهين ولا وجه لاستدراكه فإن هذا هو المذكور يعني عمرو بن سالم بن كلثوم قال وكأنهم لما رأوا الاختلاف في اسم جده ظنوه اثنين وهذا النسب الذي ذكره بن شاهين هو الذي جزم به بن الكلبي وغيره
records.english: ibn Sālim al-Khuzāʿī. Ibn Fatḥūn added him as an omission from al-Istīʿāb and related from al-Ṭabarī that he was one of those who carried the standards of Khuzāʿah on the day of the Conquest. I say: there is no basis for adding him as an omission, for he is ʿAmr ibn Sālim ibn Kulthūm al-Khuzāʿī, whom Abū ʿUmar mentioned. Ibn al-Athīr said, ‘Abū Mūsā cited this biography as an omission from Ibn Mandah and attributed it to Ibn Shāhīn, but there is no basis for adding it. This is the man already mentioned’—meaning ʿAmr ibn Sālim ibn Kulthūm. He said, ‘It seems that when they saw the disagreement concerning his grandfather’s name, they thought they were two men.’ The lineage cited by Ibn Shāhīn is the one stated decisively by Ibn al-Kalbī and others.

names.arabic: عمرو بن سالم بن حصيرة بن سالم الخزاعي
names.english: ʿAmr ibn Sālim ibn Ḥuṣayrah ibn Sālim al-Khuzāʿī

names.arabic: عمرو بن سالم بن كلثوم الخزاعي
names.english: ʿAmr ibn Sālim ibn Kulthūm al-Khuzāʿī

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: آخر أورده أبو موسى وعزاه لسعيد بن يعقوب من طريق حرام بن هشام عن أبيه عن عمرو بن سالم قال قلت يا رسول الله ان أنس بن زنيم هجاك الحديث قلت هذا هو الخزاعي وعجبت لابن الأثير كيف غفل عن التنبيه عليه مع قرب العهد به
records.english: another person of that name, listed by Abū Mūsā and attributed the entry to Saʿīd ibn Yaʿqūb, by way of Ḥarām ibn Hishām, from his father, from ʿAmr ibn Sālim, who said, ‘I said, “O Messenger of God, Anas ibn Zanīm has satirized you,”’ and the rest of the report. I say: this is the Khuzāʿī. I am surprised that Ibn al-Athīr failed to point this out despite having so recently discussed him.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: استدركه أبو موسى مستندا إلى ان عمرو بن سراقة العدوي القرشي مشهور وقد ذكر بن منده عمرو بن سراقة الأنصاري فيستدرك أحدهما قلت ولا يلزم من كون بن منده وهم في جعله انصاريا ان يكون آخر
records.english: Abū Mūsā added him as an omission on the grounds that ʿAmr ibn Surāqah al-ʿAdawī al-Qurashī is well known, whereas Ibn Mandah mentioned ʿAmr ibn Surāqah al-Anṣārī, so one of the two should be added as an omission. I say: it does not follow from Ibn Mandah’s error in making him an Anṣārī that this must be another man.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: آخر ذكره أبو موسى عن جعفر وقال قسم له عمر في وادي القرى وجعله جعفر غير العدوي فوهم فإنه هو
records.english: another person of that name, mentioned by Abū Mūsā on the authority of Ja'far and said that Umar assigned him a share in Wadi al-Qura. Ja'far treated him as someone other than al-Adawi, but this was an error, for he is the same man.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: أشار اليه بن الأثير في ترجمة عمرو بن سعد وعزاه لأبي موسى وقد وهم عليه في ذلك ولفظ أبي موسى عمرو بن سعد وقال بعضهم هو اسم أبي سعد الخير فكأنها سقطت من النسخة هو اسم أبي فنشأ منه هذا الوهم وقد تبعه صاحب التجريد ولم ينبه على صوابه
records.english: Ibn al-Athīr referred to him in the biography of Amr ibn Sa'd and attributed the notice to Abu Musa, but he was mistaken about this. Abu Musa's wording is: Amr ibn Sa'd. Some said that this was the name of Abu Sa'd al-Khayr. It appears that the words 'he is the name of Abu...' fell from the copy, giving rise to this error. The author of al-Tajrid followed him and did not point out the correct reading.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الأنصاري الأوسي كذا ذكره أبو موسى في الذيل في حرف السين ومن الآباء فوهم في استدراكه وصحف أباه وهو عمرو بن معبد أوله ميم
records.english: The Anṣārī of the Aws. Abū Mūsā mentioned him thus in the supplement under the letter sin and among the fathers' names. He erred in adding him and corrupted his father's name. He is Amr ibn Ma'bad, beginning with a mim.

names.arabic: عمرو بن سعيد بن الازعر الأنصاري الأوسي
names.english: Amr ibn Sa'id ibn al-Az'ar al-Ansari al-Awsi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن أمية بن عبد شمس الأموي المعروف بالأشدق تابعي وأبوه من صغار الصحابة جاءت عنه رواية مرسلة من طريق حفيده أيوب بن موسى عن أبيه عن جده أخرجه الترمذي وجد أيوب الادنى عمرو هذا وجده الأعلى سعيد والضمير على الصحيح يعود على موسى لا على أيوب فالحديث من مسند سعيد وقد ذكره الأشدق في الصحابة متمسكا بكون الضمير يعود على أيوب محمد بن طاهر في الأطراف وتبعه بن عساكر والمزي وقال بن عساكر في ترجمته من تاريخ دمشق يقال انه رأى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وتبعه عبد الغني والمزي وهو من المحال المقطوع ببطلانه فان أباه سعيدا كان له عند موت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ثمان سنين أو نحوها فكيف يولد له قبل عمرو سنة سبعين من الهجرة
records.english: son of Umayya ibn ʿAbd Shams, the Umayyad known as al-Ashdaq, was a Successor, while his father was among the younger Companions. A mursal report came from him through his grandson Ayyub ibn Musa, from his father, from his grandfather; al-Tirmidhi transmitted it. Ayyub's nearer grandfather is this Amr, and his more remote grandfather is Sa'id. Correctly understood, the pronoun refers to Musa, not to Ayyub, so the hadith belongs to the musnad of Sa'id. Muhammad ibn Tahir listed al-Ashdaq among the Companions on the argument that the pronoun refers to Ayyub; Ibn Asakir and al-Mizzi followed him. Ibn Asakir said in his biography in the History of Damascus, 'It is said that he saw the Prophet ﷺ,' and Abd al-Ghani and al-Mizzi followed him. This is an impossibility whose falsehood is certain: his father Sa'id was eight years old, or thereabouts, when the Prophet ﷺ died. The source then asks, in a compressed phrase whose syntax remains uncertain, how a son could have been born to him ‘before Amr, in the year seventy after the Hijra.’

names.arabic: عمرو بن سعيد بن العاص بن أمية بن عبد شمس الأموي
names.english: Amr ibn Sa'id ibn al-As ibn Umayya ibn Abd Shams al-Umawi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره بن قانع فصحف أباه والصواب شعثم بمعجمة أوله وبعد العين مثلثة وصحف بن عبد البر أباه أيضا فقال عمرو بن شعبة جعل آخره هاء
records.english: Ibn Qāniʿ mentioned him but corrupted his father's name. The correct name is Sha'tham, with a dotted letter at its beginning and a three-dotted letter after the ayn. Ibn Abd al-Barr also corrupted his father's name, saying Amr ibn Shu'ba and making its final letter a ha.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الثقفي روى حديثه روح بن عبادة عن عبد الملك بن عبد الله بن أبي سفيان عن عمه عمرو بن أبي سفيان سمع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى ان يشرب من ثلمة القدح كذا أورده بن منده وقال آراه الأول يعني عمرو بن سفيان الثقفي الماضي ذكره في الأول ومن حديثه في اسبال الإزار قلت وقد وهم في موضعين في ظنه انه راوي حديث اسبال الإزار وفي قوله سمع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم اما الأول فلأن الراوي عنه القاسم أبو عبد الرحمن الشامي ولا رواية له عن عمرو بن أبي سفيان الثقفي أصلا واما الثاني فلأنه سقط منه اسم الصحابي فان البخاري قال في التاريخ عبد الملك بن عبد الله بن أبي سفيان روى عن عمه عمرو بن سفيان بن حارثة الثقفي عن عم أبيه العلاء بن حارثة وقد اسند الحديث أبو نعيم من طريق روح بن عبادة فلم يقل فيه انه سمع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال فيه ان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى فذكره مرسلا وعمرو بن أبي سفيان بن حارثة الثقفي تابعي مشهور روى عن أبي موسى وأبي هريرة وابن عمر وغيرهم روى عنه بن أخيه عبد الملك والزهري وابن أبي حسين وغيرهم اخرج له الشيخان وأبو داود والنسائي وجاء في بعض الطرق ان اسمه عمر بضم العين
records.english: The Thaqafī. Rūḥ ibn ʿUbāda transmitted his report from Abd al-Malik ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Sufyan, from his paternal uncle Amr ibn Abi Sufyan, who heard the Prophet ﷺ prohibit drinking from a crack in a cup. Ibn Manda cited it in this form and said, 'I think he is the earlier man,' meaning Amr ibn Sufyan al-Thaqafi, mentioned previously in the first section, among whose reports is one concerning letting the lower garment hang down. I say: he erred in two places—first, in thinking that this was the transmitter of the report about letting the garment hang down, and second, in saying that he heard the Prophet ﷺ. As for the first, the transmitter from that man is al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Shami, who has no narration at all from Amr ibn Abi Sufyan al-Thaqafi. As for the second, the Companion's name has dropped from the chain. Al-Bukhari said in al-Tarikh: Abd al-Malik ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Sufyan narrated from his paternal uncle, Amr ibn Sufyan ibn Haritha al-Thaqafi, from his father's paternal uncle al-Ala ibn Haritha. Abu Nu'aym supplied the chain through Rawh ibn Ubada and did not say that he heard the Prophet ﷺ; rather, he said, 'The Prophet ﷺ prohibited it,' thus giving it as a mursal report. Amr ibn Abi Sufyan ibn Haritha al-Thaqafi was a well-known Successor. He narrated from Abu Musa, Abu Hurayra, Ibn Umar, and others, and his brother's son Abd al-Malik, al-Zuhri, Ibn Abi Husayn, and others narrated from him. The two Shaykhs, Abu Dawud, and al-Nasa'i transmitted his reports. In some routes his name appears as Umar, with a damma on the ayn.

names.arabic: عبد الملك بن عبد الله بن أبي سفيان
names.english: Abd al-Malik ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Sufyan

names.arabic: عمرو بن سفيان بن حارثة الثقفي
names.english: Amr ibn Sufyan ibn Haritha al-Thaqafi

names.arabic: عمرو بن أبي سفيان بن حارثة الثقفي
names.english: Amr ibn Abi Sufyan ibn Haritha al-Thaqafi

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الأسلمي والد أبي حدرد ذكره أبو موسى عن المستغفري والمستغفري ذكره من أجل حديث اختلف في سنده على محمد بن إسحاق وهو من رواية القعقاع بن عبد الله بن أبي حدرد عن أبيه في قصة عامر بن الاضبط فاخرج من طريق حماد بن سلمة عن محمد بن إسحاق عن يزيد بن عبد الله بن قسيط عن أبي حدرد الأسلمي عن أبيه ان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بعثه وأبا قتادة ومحلم بن جثامة في سرية فذكر الحديث وفي هذا السياق نقص أوجب الوهم فان الخبر عند جميع الرواة عن بن إسحاق عن يزيد عن القعقاع بن عبد الله بن أبي حدرد عن أبيه ومنهم من ابهم اسم القعقاع قال عن أبي القعقاع ومنهم من قال عن بن القعقاع ولكن اتفقوا على ان الحديث من مسند عبد الله بن أبي حدرد وليس لأبي حدرد فيه رواية فضلا عن أبيه وقد اختلف في اسم أبي حدرد كما أشرت اليه في سلامة من حرف السين واختلف أيضا في اسم أبيه كما سأذكره في ترجمة أبي حدرد في الكنى ان شاء الله تعالى
records.english: The Aslamī, father of Abū Ḥadrad. Abū Mūsā mentioned him on the authority of al-Mustaghfiri. Al-Mustaghfiri included him because of a report whose chain differed in transmissions from Muhammad ibn Ishaq. It is the narration of al-Qa'qa' ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Hadard, from his father, concerning the story of Amir ibn al-Adbat. He transmitted by way of Hammad ibn Salama, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Yazid ibn Abd Allah ibn Qusayt, from Abu Hadard al-Aslami, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ sent him, Abu Qatada, and Muhallim ibn Jaththama on an expedition, and then related the report. This wording contains an omission that caused the error. Among all transmitters, the report is from Ibn Ishaq, from Yazid, from al-Qa'qa' ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Hadard, from his father. Some left al-Qa'qa's name unspecified and said 'from the father of al-Qa'qa',' while others said 'from Ibn al-Qa'qa'.' They all agreed, however, that the report belongs to the musnad of Abd Allah ibn Abi Hadard. Abu Hadard has no narration in it, much less his father. There is disagreement over Abu Hadard's name, as I indicated under Salama in the letter sin, and there is also disagreement over his father's name, as I shall mention in the biography of Abu Hadard among the kunyās, ان شاء الله تعالى.

names.arabic: القعقاع بن عبد الله بن أبي حدرد
names.english: al-Qa'qa' ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Hadard

names.arabic: يزيد بن عبد الله بن قسيط
names.english: Yazid ibn Abd Allah ibn Qusayt

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الضمري وقع كذلك في العلل للدارقطني من طريق حيوة بن شريح عن بن الهاد عن محمد بن إبراهيم عن عيسى بن طلحة والصواب عمير بن سلمة كذلك رواه الدراوردي وغيره عن بن الهاد
records.english: The Ḍamrī. He appears thus in al-Dāraquṭnī’s al-ʿIlal through Haywa ibn Shurayh, from Ibn al-Had, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Isa ibn Talha. The correct name is Umayr ibn Salama; al-Darawardi and others transmitted it in that form from Ibn al-Had.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: الزرقي ذكره أبو موسى عن سعيد بن يعقوب وقال لا صحبة له وأورد له من طريق عن عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير عنه حديث إذا دخل أحدكم مسجدا فليصل ركعتين وهذا الحديث مخرج في الصحيحين من رواية مالك عن عمرو بن سليم عن أبي قتادة وهو الصواب
records.english: The Zurāqī. Abū Mūsā mentioned him on the authority of Sa'id ibn Ya'qub and said that he had no Companionship. He cited for him, through Amir ibn Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, the report: 'When one of you enters a mosque, let him pray two rak'as.' This hadith is transmitted in the two Sahihs in Malik's narration from Amr ibn Sulaym, from Abu Qatada, and that is the correct chain.

names.arabic: عامر بن عبد الله بن الزبير
names.english: Amir ibn Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: المزني ذكره بن قانع واخرج من طريق إسماعيل بن أبي إياس سمعت عمرو بن سليمان المزني سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول العجوة من الجنة ووهم بن قانع فيه من وجهين فإنه صحف اسم أبيه وحذف شيخه والصواب ما أخرجه بن ماجة وغيره من هذا الوجه عن عمرو بن سليم المزني عن رافع بن عمر المزني وهو الصواب
records.english: The Muzanī. Ibn Qāniʿ mentioned him and transmitted by way of Isma'il ibn Abi Iyas: 'I heard Amr ibn Sulayman al-Muzani say: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say, “Ajwa dates are from Paradise.”' Ibn Qani' erred in two respects: he corrupted the father's name and omitted the man's shaykh. The correct version is what Ibn Majah and others transmitted by this route, from Amr ibn Sulaym al-Muzani, from Rafi' ibn Amr al-Muzani.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن الحارث الأوسي الظفري أبو لبيد أورده يحيى بن عبد الوهاب بن منده مستدركا على جده وأورد له من حديث قتادة بن النعمان ان بعض المنافقين اتهمه بالدرع فبرأه الله تعالى قال بن الأثير وهم فيه يحيى فإن جميع من صنف في الصحابة وجميع من صنف في النسب ذكروا القصة للبيد بن سليم وقد تقدمت في ترجمة رفاعة بن زيد على الصواب قلت فلعله كان يكنى أبا عمرو فانقلب
records.english: son of al-Ḥārith, of the Aws and Banū Ẓafar, known as Abū Labīd. Yahya ibn Abd al-Wahhab ibn Manda added him as an omission from his grandfather's work and cited for him the report from Qatada ibn al-Nu'man that some hypocrites accused him concerning the coat of mail, whereupon God تعالى exonerated him. Ibn al-Athir said: Yahya erred concerning him, for everyone who wrote on the Companions and everyone who wrote on genealogy related the story about Lubayd ibn Sulaym. It was given correctly above in the biography of Rifa'a ibn Zayd. I say: perhaps he had the kunya Abu Amr and the elements were reversed.

names.arabic: عمرو بن سهل بن الحارث الأوسي الظفري
names.english: Amr ibn Sahl ibn al-Harith al-Awsi al-Zafari

aliases: son of al-Ḥārith, of the Aws and Banū Ẓafar, known as Abū Labīd

names.arabic: يحيى بن عبد الوهاب بن منده
names.english: Yahya ibn Abd al-Wahhab ibn Manda

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: وقع في شرح شيخنا بن الملقن في باب غسل الخلوق من شرح البخاري له ما نصه هذا الرجل هو الذي جاء وعليه الخلوق يجوز ان يكون عمرو بن سواد إذ في الشفاء للقاضي عياض عنه أتيت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وانا مخلق فقال ورس ورس حط حط وغشاني بقضيب بيده في بطني فأوجعني الحديث لكن عمرو هذا لا يدرك ذا فإنه صاحب بن وهب قلت ان ثبت الخبر فهو آخر وافق اسمه وأسم أبيه لكن القصة معروفة لسواد بن عمرو كما تقدم في ترجمته فالظاهر انه انقلب
records.english: He appears in our shaykh Ibn al-Mulaqqin’s commentary, in the chapter on washing off scented dye in his commentary on al-Bukhari, there appears the following text: 'This man is the one who came wearing scented dye. It is possible that he was Amr ibn Sawad, since al-Qadi Iyad's al-Shifa reports from him: “I came to the Prophet ﷺ while scented with dye, and he said: ‘Wars, wars! Remove it, remove it!’ He then prodded me in the abdomen with a stick in his hand and hurt me,”' to the end of the report. But this Amr could not have lived at that time, for he was a companion of Ibn Wahb. I say: if the report is sound, then this was another man whose own name and father's name agreed with his. Yet the story is known of Sawad ibn Amr, as previously given in his biography, so it appears that the names were reversed.

records.arabic: الثقفي تابعي معروف سيأتي شرح خبره في ترجمة محمد بن الشريد
records.english: The Thaqafī, a well-known Successor. An explanation of his report will appear in the biography of Muhammad ibn al-Sharid.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره بن فتحون عن الأموي في مغازيه وانه الذي حلق رأس رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في حجة الوداع قلت وهذا خطأ نشأ عن تصحيف وانما هو معمر وسيأتي على الصواب
records.english: Ibn Fatḥūn mentioned him on the authority of al-Umawi in his Maghazi and said that he was the one who shaved the head of the Messenger of God ﷺ during the Farewell Pilgrimage. I say: this is an error caused by a scribal corruption. The correct name is Ma'mar, and it will appear in its proper form.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: تقدم التنبيه عليه في القسم الأول وانه عمرو بن عبيد الله بالتصغير الحضرمي
records.english: Attention was drawn to him earlier in the first section: he is Amr ibn Ubayd Allah, in the diminutive, al-Hadrami.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: البجلي أبو حازم والد قيس أورده جعفر المستغفري وتبعه أبو موسى قال والمشهور ان اسمه عبد عوف قلت وهو الصواب
records.english: The Bajalī, known as Abū Ḥāzim and father of Qays. Ja'far al-Mustaghfiri included him, and Abu Musa followed him. He said that the well-known form of his name is Abd Awf. I say: that is correct.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره سعيد بن يعقوب وهو خطأ نشأ عن تصحيف فروى من طريق علي بن خالد عن مكحول ان عمرو بن عقبة قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من صام يوما في سبيل الله بعد من النار مسيرة مائة عام قال سعيد أراه عمرو بن عبسة قلت هو هو والحديث حديثه
records.english: Saʿīd ibn Yaʿqūb mentioned him, but this was an error caused by a scribal corruption. He narrated through Ali ibn Khalid, from Makhul, that Amr ibn Uqba said: the Messenger of God ﷺ said, 'Whoever fasts one day in the path of God will be placed a hundred years' journey away from the Fire.' Sa'id said, 'I think he is Amr ibn Abasa.' I say: he is indeed that man, and the hadith is his.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره المستغفري فقال شهد بدرا وهو وهم والصواب عمير بالتصغير
records.english: Al-Mustaghfirī mentioned him and said that he witnessed Badr, but this is an error. The correct name is Umayr, in the diminutive.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: تابعي كبير مخضرم ذكره سعيد بن يعقوب براوية موهومة وقد بينا ذلك في القسم الذي قبله
records.english: A senior Successor who lived through the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods. Sa'id ibn Ya'qub mentioned him on the basis of an erroneous narration; we explained this in the preceding section.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ذكره سعيد بن يعقوب قال كان له رئي في الجاهلية الحديث وقد صحف أباه وانما هو ابيش بهمزة لا بعين
records.english: Saʿīd ibn Yaʿqūb mentioned him and said: 'He had a familiar spirit in the pre-Islamic period,' to the end of the report. He corrupted the father's name. It is actually Ubayish, with a hamza, not an ayn.

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن مازن بن قيس بن أبي صعصعة الخزرجي أورده جعفر المستغفري فيمن شهد بدرا من الأنصار وذكره أيضا فيمن نزل فيه قوله تعالى تولوا وأعينهم تفيض من الدمع حزنا هكذا أورده أبو موسى في الذيل وهو وهم إبتدأ به جعفر وتبعه أبو موسى وراج على بن الأثير مع تحققه بمعرفة النسب وقلده الذهبي وبيان الوهم فيه أظهر فيما ساقه بن إسحاق وغيره من أهل المغازي فقالوا ومن بني عمرو بن غنم بن مازن قيس بن أبي صعصعة بن زيد بن عوف بن مبذول بن عمرو بن غنم فكأنه انقلب على جعفر فوقع فيه هذا الوهم الفاحش فإنه عمرو بن غنم بن مازن جد قبيلة كبيرة من الخزرج ثم من بني النجار
records.english: son of Māzin ibn Qays ibn Abī Ṣaʿṣaʿa, the Khazrajī. Ja'far al-Mustaghfiri listed him among the Ansar who witnessed Badr and also among those concerning whom His saying تعالى was revealed: 'They turned away while their eyes overflowed with tears of sorrow.' Abu Musa presented him in this form in the supplement. This error originated with Ja'far; Abu Musa followed him, it passed unnoticed by Ibn al-Athir despite his sound knowledge of genealogy, and al-Dhahabi imitated him. The error is clearest from what Ibn Ishaq and other authorities on military campaigns related. They said: 'Among the descendants of Amr ibn Ghanm ibn Mazin was Qays ibn Abi Sa'sa'a ibn Zayd ibn Awf ibn Mabdhul ibn Amr ibn Ghanm.' It seems the order was reversed for Ja'far, producing this grave error. Amr ibn Ghanm ibn Mazin was the ancestor of a large clan of the Khazraj, specifically of Banu al-Najjar.

names.arabic: عمرو بن غنم بن مازن بن قيس بن أبي صعصعة الخزرجي
names.english: Amr ibn Ghanm ibn Mazin ibn Qays ibn Abi Sa'sa'a al-Khazraji

names.arabic: أبي صعصعة بن زيد بن عوف بن مبذول بن عمرو بن غنم
names.english: Qays ibn Abi Sa'sa'a ibn Zayd ibn Awf ibn Mabdhul ibn Amr ibn Ghanm

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: بن عمرو الغفاري نبهت عليه في القسم الأول
records.english: son of ʿAmr, the Ghifārī. I drew attention to him in the first section.

names.arabic: عمرو بن كعب بن عمرو الغفاري
names.english: Amr ibn Ka'b ibn Amr al-Ghifari

license.attribution: OpenITI, JK000533 transcription of Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani's al-Isabah fi Tamyiz al-Sahabah

records.arabic: ملاعب الأسنة كذا ذكره بن منده وأبو نعيم والصواب ان اسمه عامر وقد مضى على الصواب
records.english: Known as Mulāʿib al-Asinna; Ibn Manda mentioned him thus and Abu Nu'aym gave the name in this form. Correctly, his name is Amir, and he has already appeared under the correct form.

records.arabic: والد يزيد بن عمرو أورده بن شاهين وساق من طريق يزيد بن عمرو بن مسلم عن أبيه عن جده حديثا والصحبة والحديث إنما هما ليزيد وسيأتي على الصواب في موضعه قال أبو موسى والحديث لمسلم لا لعمرو والسبب في وهمه انه سقط عليه قوله عن أبيه وانما وقع عنده عن يزيد بن عمرو قال حدثنا أبي قال شهدت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وقد انشدوه شعرا لسويد بن عامر فقال لو أدرك هذا الإسلام لاسلم كذا ذكره هنا مختصرا وقد ساقه بن منده في ترجمة مسلم بن الحارث مطولا وسيأتي من هذا الوجه فقال حدثني أبي عن أبيه قال شهدت وقد وجدته في هامش كتاب بن شاهين وكأنه من إصلاح غيره لأنه لم يترجم له في حرف الميم في مسلم ولو كان وقع عنده عن أبيه لذكره في ترجمة مسلم كما صنع بن منده
records.english: Father of Yazīd ibn ʿAmr. Ibn Shāhīn included him and cited, through Yazid ibn Amr ibn Muslim, from his father, from his grandfather, a hadith. The Companionship and the hadith belong to Yazid, who will appear correctly in his proper place. Abu Musa said: 'The hadith belongs to Muslim, not to Amr.' The reason for Ibn Shahin's error is that the words 'from his father' dropped out of his copy. What he had was simply: 'From Yazid ibn Amr, who said: my father narrated to us, saying: I witnessed the Prophet ﷺ while they recited to him poetry by Suwayd ibn Amir, and he said, “Had this man lived to see Islam, he would have embraced it.”' He mentioned it here in abbreviated form. Ibn Manda related it at length in the biography of Muslim ibn al-Harith, and it will appear by this route, where he said, 'My father related to me from his father, who said: I witnessed...' I found it in the margin of Ibn Shahin's book, seemingly a correction by someone else, because Ibn Shahin did not give him an entry under mim as Muslim. Had the words 'from his father' stood in his copy, he would have included him in Muslim's biography, as Ibn Manda did.

records.arabic: ذكره بن أبي علي في الصحابة وعزاه لابن أبي عاصم وهو ما رواه عن سلمة بن شبيب عن عبد الرزاق عن معمر عن الزهري عن عرفجة بن محمد عن عمرو بن مطعم عن أبيه ان أباه أخبره انه بينما هو يسير مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مقفله من حنين فلقيه الاعراب يسألونه كذا رواه معمر ونبه مسلم في أوائل كتاب اليمين له على وهم معمر فيه قال وهو عمر بن محمد بن جبير بن مطعم لا شك فيه ولم يكن لجبير أخ اسمه عمرو لا يختلف أهل النسب في ذلك قلت والحديث المذكور مشهور لجبير بن مطعم كذا رواه أصحاب الزهري عنه وقد وقع عند إسحاق الدبري عن عبد الرزاق في هذا الإسناد ان أباه جبيرا أخبره فذكر الحديث وهذا أصرح ما يتمسك به في ذلك
records.english: Ibn Abī ʿAlī mentioned him among the Companions and attributed the report to Ibn Abi Asim. It is what the latter narrated from Salama ibn Shabib, from Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Arfaja ibn Muhammad, from Amr ibn Mut'im, from his father, that his father informed him that while he was traveling with the Prophet ﷺ on his return from Hunayn, the Bedouins met him and asked him for things, to the end of the report. Ma'mar narrated it in this form. Near the beginning of his Book of Oaths, Muslim pointed out Ma'mar's error and said: 'He is Umar ibn Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im, without doubt. Jubayr had no brother named Amr; genealogists do not disagree about that.' I say: the cited hadith is well known as the report of Jubayr ibn Mut'im; al-Zuhri's transmitters related it from him in that form. In this chain as transmitted by Ishaq al-Dabari from Abd al-Razzaq, the wording is 'that his father, Jubayr, informed him,' followed by the report. This is the clearest evidence on which to rely in this matter.

names.arabic: عمر بن محمد بن جبير بن مطعم لا
names.english: Umar ibn Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im

records.english: Ibn Manda mentioned him; the correct name is Ṭalḥa ibn Naḍla, as given above.

records.arabic: بن معبد تابعي معروف أخرجه الباوردي في الصحابة وساق من طريق معمر عن منصور عن هلال بن يساف عن زياد بن أبي الجعد عن عمرو بن وابصة ان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أبصر رجلا يصلى خلف الصف فامره ان يعيد وهذا خطأ نشأ عن تصحيف وانما هو عن عمرو عن وابصة فتصحف عن فصارت بن فعمرو هو بن رشد والصحابي هو وابصة فقد أخرجه أبو داود والترمذي من طريق شعبة عن عمرو بن مرة عن هلال على الصواب
records.english: son of Maʿbad was a well-known Successor. Al-Bawardi included him among the Companions and cited by way of Ma'mar, from Mansur, from Hilal ibn Yasaf, from Ziyad ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Amr ibn Wabisa, that the Prophet ﷺ saw a man praying behind the row and ordered him to repeat the prayer. This is an error caused by a scribal corruption. The chain actually reads 'from Amr, from Wabisa.' The word 'from' was corrupted into 'son of.' Amr is Ibn Rushd, and the Companion is Wabisa. Abu Dawud and al-Tirmidhi transmitted it correctly by way of Shu'ba, from Amr ibn Murra, from Hilal.

records.arabic: ذكره البغوي والباوردي وابن قانع وابن منده وابن فتحون وهو خطأ نشأ عن سقط أو قلب فانهم اوردوا من طريق إسماعيل بن عبد الله بن أبي المهاجر عن عطية بن عمرو السعدي عن أبيه قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لا تسأل الناس شيئا ومال الله مسئول ومنطى وهذا هو عطية بن عمرو السعدي والحديث معروف لإسماعيل عن بن عطية السعدي عن أبيه
records.english: Al-Baghawī, al-Bāwardī, and Ibn Qāniʿ mentioned him. Ibn Manda and Ibn Fathun also mentioned him. This is an error caused by an omission or reversal. They cited through Isma'il ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi al-Muhajir, from Atiyya ibn Amr al-Sa'di, from his father, who said: the Messenger of God ﷺ said, 'Do not ask people for anything; God's property is asked for and given.' This man is Atiyya ibn Amr al-Sa'di, and the hadith is known through Isma'il, from Ibn Atiyya al-Sa'di, from his father.

names.arabic: إسماعيل بن عبد الله بن أبي المهاجر
names.english: Isma'il ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi al-Muhajir

records.english: Yaḥyā ibn Yūnus al-Shīrāzī named him thus, and Abu Musa added him as an omission, but this was an error. He is Khuwaylid ibn Amr: Amr is his father's name. He has appeared above in the correct form.

records.arabic:
بن ظبيان بن لوذان بن الحارث بن سدوس السدوسي ويقال الذهلي يكنى أبا شهاب تابعي مشهور وكان من رءوس الخوارج من القعدية بفتحتين وهم الذين يحسنون لغيرهم الخروج على المسلمين ولا يباشرون القتال قاله المبرد قال وكان من الصفرية وقيل القعدية لا يورن الحرب وان كانوا يزينونه وقال أبو الفرج اللاصبهاني إنما صار عمران قعديا بعد ان كبر وعجز عن الحرب وقال بن البرقي كان حروريا وقال بن حبان في الثقات كان يميل إلى مذهب الشراة قلت وقال المرزباني شاعر مفلق مكثرو من قوله السائر
أيها المادح العباد ليعطى
ان الله ما بايدي العباد
فاسأل الله ما طلبت إليهم
وارج فضل المهيمن العواد لم يذكره أحد في الصحابة الا ما وقع في تعليقة القاضي حسين بن محمد الشافعي شيخ المراوزة فإنه ذكر أبيات عمران هذا التي رثى بها عبد الرحمن بن ملجم قاتل على يقول فيها
يا ضربة من تقي ما أراد بها
الا ليبلغ من ذي العرش رضوانا
اني لاذكره يوما فاحسبه
أوفى البرية عند الله ميزانا قال فعارضه الامام أبو الطيب الطبري فقال
اني لابرأ مما أنت تذكره
عن بن ملجم الملعون بهتانا
اني لاذكره يوما فألعنه
دينا وألعن عمران بن حطانا قال القاضي حسين هذا الذي قاله القاضي أبو الطيب خطأ فان عمران صحابي لا تجوز لعنته وهكذا قرأت بخط القاضي تاج الدين السبكي وذكر انه وجد حاشية على التعليقة ما نصه هذا غلو من القاضي حسين وكيف لا يلعن عمران وقد فعل ما فعل وطول من هذا المعنى قال القاضي تاج الدين وعجب من الأمرين وليس عمران صحابيا وانما هو من الخوارج وقد إجابة عن أبياته المذكورة من القدماء بكر بن حماد التاهرتي وهو من أهل القيروان في عصر البخاري وأجاب عنها السيد الحميري الشاعر المشهور الشيعي وهي في ديوانه واجابه عنها أبو المظفر الشهد ستأتي في كتابه التبصير وقد اخرج البخاري وأبو داود لعمران بن حطان من رواية يحيى بن أبي كثير عنه عن عائشة حديثا واعتذروا عنه بأنه إنما اخرج عنه لكونه تاب فقد ذكر المعافى في تارخ الموصل عن محمد بن بشر العبدي قال ما مات عمران بن حطان حتى رجع عن رأي الخوارج وقيل إنما خرج عنه ما حدث به قبل ان يبتدع فقد قال يعقوب بن شيبة أدرك جماعة من الصحابة وصار في آخر امره ان رأى رأي الخوارج وكان سبب ذلك انه تزوج ابنة عم له فبلغه انها دخلت في رأى الخوارج فأراد ان يردها عن ذلك فصرفته إلى مذهبها وقال يعقوب بن شيبة حديثه عن الأصمعي عن معتمر بن سليمان عن عثمان البتي قال كان عمران من أهل السنة فقدم غلام من عمان كأنه يصل بقلبه في مجلس وفي هذا الاعتذار نظر فان يحيى بن أبي كثير إنما سمع منه حال هربه من الحجاج وكان الحجاج يطلبه ليقتله بسبب رأى الخوارج وقصته في ذلك مع روح بن زنباع وعبد الملك بن مروان مشهورة ذكرها المبرد وغيره واعتذر أبو داود عن التخريج له بان الخوارج أصح أهل الأهواء حديثا ثم ذكر عمران وانظاره وروى عن التبوذكي عن أبان العطار قال سمعت قتادة يقول كان عمران لا يتهم في الحديث وقال العجلي بصري تابعي ثقة وطعن العقيلي في روايته عن عائشة فقال عمران بن حطان لا يتابع في حديثه وكان يرى رأى الخوارج ولم يتبين سماعه من عائشة وكذا جزم بن عبد البر بأنه لم يسمع منها وفيه نظر لان في الحديث الذي أخرجه البخاري تصريحه بسماعه منها وكذا وقع في المعجم الصغير للطبراني بسند صحيح اليه وقال العباس بن الفرج الرياشي حدثنا أبو الوليد الطيالسي عن أبي عمرو بن العلاء عن صالح بن شريح الأسدي عن عمران بن حطان قال كنت عند عائشة فذكر قصة وممن عاب على البخاري إخراج حديثه الدارقطني فقال عمران متروك لسوء اعتقاده وخبث مذهبه وقال بن قانع مات سنة أربع وثمانين من الهجرة
records.english:
son of Ẓabyān ibn Lawdhān ibn al-Ḥārith ibn Sadūs, the Sadūsī, also called al-Dhuhli, had the kunya Abu Shihab. He was a well-known Successor and one of the leaders of the Qa'adiyya Kharijites—the name, with both vowels open, denotes those who commend rebellion against the Muslims to others but do not themselves take part in the fighting, as al-Mubarrad explained. He said that Imran belonged to the Sufriyya. It is also said that the Qa'adiyya do not kindle war, although they encourage it. Abu al-Faraj al-Isfahani said that Imran became a Qa'adi only after he had grown old and become incapable of warfare. Ibn al-Barqi said that he was a Haruri, while Ibn Hibban, in al-Thiqat, said that he inclined toward the doctrine of the Shurat. I say: al-Marzubani called him an accomplished and prolific poet. Among his widely quoted verses are:
O you who praise men in hope of being given,
God possesses whatever rests in men's hands.
Ask God for what you have sought from them,
And hope for the bounty of the Guardian who gives again.
No one included him among the Companions except for a statement in the Ta'liqa of al-Qadi Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Shafi'i, the shaykh of the people of Marw. He cited the verses in which this Imran elegized Abd al-Rahman ibn Muljam, Ali's killer:
O blow struck by a God-fearing man, who intended by it
Only to attain the pleasure of the Lord of the Throne!
Whenever I recall him, I reckon him
The creature whose scale is fullest before God.
Imam Abu al-Tayyib al-Tabari answered him:
I disavow what you relate
About the accursed Ibn Muljam—mere slander.
Whenever I recall him, I curse him
As an act of faith, and I curse Imran ibn Hittan.
Al-Qadi Husayn said, 'What al-Qadi Abu al-Tayyib said is wrong, for Imran was a Companion and may not be cursed.' This is how I read it in al-Qadi Taj al-Din al-Subki's handwriting. He also mentioned finding a marginal note on the Ta'liqa that read: 'This is excess on al-Qadi Husayn's part. How could Imran not be cursed after doing what he did?' The note went on at length in this vein. Al-Qadi Taj al-Din said: 'Both positions are astonishing. Imran was not a Companion; he was one of the Kharijites.' Among the earlier poets who answered the cited verses was Bakr ibn Hammad al-Taharti, a man of Qayrawan in al-Bukhari's time. Al-Sayyid al-Himyari, the famous Shi'i poet, also answered them; his response is in his diwan. Abu al-Muzaffar al-Shahd, whose notice will appear in his book al-Tabsir, answered them as well. Al-Bukhari and Abu Dawud transmitted from Imran ibn Hittan his narration from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from him, from A'isha. They excused doing so by saying that he had repented. Al-Mu'afa related in the History of Mosul, from Muhammad ibn Bishr al-Abdi, that Imran ibn Hittan did not die until he had renounced the Kharijite doctrine. It is also said that they transmitted from him only what he had narrated before adopting his innovation. Ya'qub ibn Shayba said that he met a number of the Companions and, late in life, adopted the Kharijite doctrine. The cause was that he married a female cousin. When he learned that she had adopted the Kharijite view, he intended to turn her away from it, but she instead converted him to her doctrine. Ya'qub ibn Shayba also related, through al-Asma'i, from Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman, from Uthman al-Batti, that Imran had belonged to the Sunnis, until a youth came from Oman who seemed to win over his heart in a gathering. This defense is questionable, for Yahya ibn Abi Kathir heard from him while he was fleeing al-Hajjaj, who sought to kill him because of his Kharijite beliefs. His story in this connection with Rawh ibn Zinba' and Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan is well known and was related by al-Mubarrad and others. Abu Dawud defended transmitting from him on the ground that the Kharijites were the most accurate hadith transmitters among the sectarians, and then mentioned Imran and his peers. Al-Tabudhaki narrated from Aban al-Attar: 'I heard Qatada say that Imran was not suspected in hadith.' Al-Ijli said: 'A Basran Successor, trustworthy.' Al-Uqayli criticized his narration from A'isha, saying: 'Imran ibn Hittan has no corroboration for his hadith. He held the Kharijite view, and it has not been established that he heard from A'isha.' Ibn Abd al-Barr likewise stated categorically that he had not heard from her. That is questionable, because the hadith transmitted by al-Bukhari explicitly says that he heard from her. The same wording occurs in al-Tabarani's al-Mu'jam al-Saghir through a sound chain to him. Al-Abbas ibn al-Faraj al-Riyashi said: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi narrated to us, from Abu Amr ibn al-Ala, from Salih ibn Shurayh al-Asadi, from Imran ibn Hittan, who said: 'I was with A'isha,' and then related a story. Among those who criticized al-Bukhari for transmitting his hadith was al-Daraqutni, who said: 'Imran is abandoned because of his corrupt creed and vile doctrine.' Ibn Qani' said that he died in the year eighty-four after the Hijra.

names.arabic: عمران بن حطان بن ظبيان بن لوذان بن الحارث بن سدوس السدوسي
names.english: Imran ibn Hittan ibn Zabyan ibn Lawdhan ibn al-Harith ibn Sadus al-Sadusi
